title.zh: 圣诞帽奶蛙：大家都在大笑

description.en: Santa-hat Naiwa bends forward holding its belly and laughing; the caption says, “Everyone is laughing out loud.”
description.zh: 戴圣诞帽的奶蛙弯腰捧腹大笑，画面配字“大家都在大笑”。

description.en: Two Naiwa figures support a huge basket overflowing with flowers.
description.zh: 两只奶蛙合力撑着装满鲜花的巨大篮子。

title.en: The Flock Is Watching Me Too

description.en: Naiwa looks up at a flock of birds arranged like a giant eye.
description.zh: 奶蛙仰望排成巨大眼睛形状的鸟群。

title.en: Leave the Sound outside the Veil

description.en: A larger Naiwa leans over a veiled cradle containing a small Naiwa.
description.zh: 大奶蛙俯身看着罩纱摇篮里的小奶蛙。

title.en: A Small Body between the Branches

description.en: A small Naiwa stands on a dark branch in a mostly monochrome scene.
description.zh: 小奶蛙站在深色树枝上，背景主要为黑白色。

description.en: Naiwa appears in an ornate golden portrait surrounded by tiny patterns.
description.zh: 奶蛙出现在华丽金色肖像中，周围布满细小纹样。

description.en: Naiwa tends to a sleeping dog's long ear on a red rug.
description.zh: 奶蛙在红毯上整理睡狗的长耳朵。

title.en: Leave the Path for a Moment

description.en: Naiwa steps to the side of a stone path while a snail crosses ahead.
description.zh: 奶蛙让到石板路边，前方有蜗牛爬过。

description.en: Two Naiwa figures carry glowing paper lanterns among flowers.
description.zh: 两只奶蛙在花丛中提着发光纸灯笼。

description.en: Naiwa stands on a large shell with other Naiwa figures around the shore.
description.zh: 奶蛙站在大贝壳上，岸边还有其他奶蛙。

description.en: Naiwa pours blue water onto a paper street map.
description.zh: 奶蛙将蓝色的水倒在纸质街道地图上。

description.en: Four Naiwa figures ride in a tilted sailboat among choppy waves.
description.zh: 四只奶蛙乘坐倾斜帆船，在波浪间航行。

description.en: Naiwa sweeps orange leaves with a branch-shaped broom.
description.zh: 奶蛙用树枝状扫帚清扫橙色树叶。

description.en: Two Naiwa figures stretch a large white sheet beneath a blue sky.
description.zh: 两只奶蛙在蓝天下撑开一张大白布。

title.en: A Small Harvest Close to the Ground

description.en: Three Naiwa figures gather crops close to the ground in a field.
description.zh: 三只奶蛙在田间俯身拾取作物。

description.en: Naiwa ties blue laces through a crack in a terracotta flowerpot.
description.zh: 奶蛙将蓝绳穿过陶花盆的裂缝并系紧。

description.en: A large Naiwa helps a small Naiwa wash its foot over a basin.
description.zh: 大奶蛙扶着小奶蛙，在水盆上方给它洗脚。

description.en: Two Naiwa figures wrap their arms around opposite sides of a tree trunk.
description.zh: 两只奶蛙从树干两侧伸臂围抱。

title.en: Do Not Touch This Breath Yet

description.en: Naiwa blows a clear soap bubble while a smaller Naiwa watches nearby.
description.zh: 奶蛙吹出透明肥皂泡，小奶蛙在旁观看。

description.en: Naiwa waters a sprout growing between the pages of a thick book.
description.zh: 奶蛙给厚书书页间长出的幼苗浇水。

description.en: A small Naiwa stands on a red stage facing rows of empty blue seats.
description.zh: 小奶蛙站在红色舞台上，面对成排空蓝座椅。

description.en: Two Naiwa figures return through a snowy landscape with a group of dogs.
description.zh: 两只奶蛙带着一群狗穿过雪景归来。

title.en: Stand the Other Way for a While

description.en: Naiwa performs a handstand against a simple blue and red background.
description.zh: 奶蛙在简洁的蓝红背景前倒立。

description.en: Naiwa wears a pale tutu and extends its arms across a theatre stage.
description.zh: 奶蛙穿浅色芭蕾裙，在剧场舞台上伸展双臂。

description.en: Naiwa lies on its back in the snow with spread limbs and fan-shaped marks.
description.zh: 奶蛙张开四肢仰卧雪地，周围留下扇形划痕。

description.en: Naiwa stands on a stool to place a cherry on a tall stack of pancakes.
description.zh: 奶蛙站在凳子上，把樱桃放到高高的煎饼堆顶端。

description.en: Three Naiwa figures rest at different positions along a blue riverbank.
description.zh: 三只奶蛙在蓝色河岸的不同位置休息。

title.en: Pulling the White Line into a Curve

description.en: Naiwa pulls a line-marking cart that draws a curving white line on grass.
description.zh: 奶蛙拉着划线车，在草地上画出弯曲白线。

description.en: Naiwa reads a small red book while seated beside a purple cushion.
description.zh: 奶蛙坐在紫色软垫旁读一本红色小书。

description.en: Naiwa crouches over a large blue kite and presses a patch onto it.
description.zh: 奶蛙蹲在大蓝风筝旁，将补片压在风筝上。

description.en: Naiwa sits at a table and touches a large globe beside an open book.
description.zh: 奶蛙坐在桌前触碰大球仪，旁边摊着书。

description.en: Naiwa sits on a bench tightening the laces of its red ice skates.
description.zh: 奶蛙坐在长凳上系紧红色冰鞋的鞋带。

title.en: A Breath Held a Little Longer

description.en: Naiwa wears a dark uniform and red trousers while holding a flute to its mouth.
description.zh: 奶蛙穿深色制服与红裤子，双手将笛子举到嘴边。

description.en: Naiwa turns a wicker basket sideways to carry it through a narrow gate.
description.zh: 奶蛙把柳条篮侧转，准备穿过狭窄的门。

description.en: Naiwa faces a large pale animal in a colourful collage-like village scene.
description.zh: 奶蛙在彩色拼贴般的村庄画面里面对一只浅色大动物。

description.en: Naiwa checks a black bicycle inner tube in a basin of water.
description.zh: 奶蛙把黑色自行车内胎放在水盆里检查。

description.en: Naiwa sits sideways in dark clothes against a quiet grey wall.
description.zh: 奶蛙穿深色衣服侧坐在安静的灰墙前。

description.en: Naiwa stands by the river with one arm drawn back holding a flat stone.
description.zh: 奶蛙站在河边，一只手臂向后展开拿着扁石。

title.en: The Feet Rise Before the Bell Rings

description.en: Naiwa hangs above the floor while pulling a bell rope in a tall tower.
description.zh: 奶蛙在高钟楼中拉着钟绳，双脚悬离地面。

description.en: A large and small Naiwa hold hands while climbing stone steps beside the water.
description.zh: 大小奶蛙牵手攀上水边的石阶。

title.en: Make a Little Room for the Belly

description.en: Naiwa stoops beneath low attic beams and hanging stockings.
description.zh: 奶蛙在低矮阁楼横梁与悬挂长袜之间弯腰前行。

description.en: Two dressed Naiwa figures share an umbrella on a wet city street.
description.zh: 两只穿衣的奶蛙在湿漉漉的城市街道上共撑一把伞。

description.en: Naiwa twists a blue towel above a white basin.
description.zh: 奶蛙在白盆上方拧蓝色毛巾。

description.en: A red studio room contains several Naiwa pictures and small figures.
description.zh: 红色画室里陈列着多幅奶蛙图画和小型形象。

description.en: Naiwa turns a sharpener's crank while guiding a very long blue pencil.
description.zh: 奶蛙扶着很长的蓝铅笔，转动卷笔刀手柄。

title.en: Give This Handful to the Earth

description.en: A hat-wearing Naiwa scatters seeds across a purple-blue field beneath a large sun.
description.zh: 戴帽子的奶蛙在大太阳下的紫蓝田野中播撒种子。

description.en: Naiwa holds a nail against an overturned red stool and raises a hammer.
description.zh: 奶蛙扶着倒置红凳上的钉子，举起锤子。

description.en: Naiwa rows a narrow boat across a calm river.
description.zh: 奶蛙划着窄船穿过平静河面。

title.en: Let the Rain Reach My Face

description.en: Naiwa tilts its face upward and opens its arms beneath heavy rain.
description.zh: 奶蛙在密集雨水中仰脸、张开双臂。

description.en: Dark-clothed Naiwa figures gather at tables in a dim café-like interior.
description.zh: 穿深色衣服的奶蛙们聚在昏暗咖啡馆般的室内桌旁。

description.en: Several Naiwa figures pass in two directions along a narrow path over water.
description.zh: 几只奶蛙在水上的窄路上双向相向而行。

description.en: A formally dressed Naiwa holds a flower against a swirling multicoloured background.
description.zh: 穿正式服装的奶蛙拿着花，背景是旋转般的多彩纹样。

description.en: Three Naiwa figures occupy separate levels of a colourful geometric building.
description.zh: 三只奶蛙分别位于彩色几何建筑的不同层面。

title.en: The Ball Is Still Near the Hands

description.en: Striped-costume Naiwa figures reach for a ball beneath autumn trees.
description.zh: 穿条纹服装的奶蛙在秋树下伸手接球。

title.en: A Circle of Water for Each

description.en: Three Naiwa figures float partly submerged in dark blue water.
description.zh: 三只奶蛙半浸在深蓝水中漂浮。

title.en: Only This Patch of Ground Beneath the Umbrellas

description.en: Dressed Naiwa figures crowd beneath overlapping blue-grey umbrellas.
description.zh: 穿衣的奶蛙挤在层叠的蓝灰雨伞下。

description.en: Four train windows frame Naiwa figures looking in different directions.
description.zh: 四扇火车窗里分别有朝不同方向看的奶蛙。

description.en: Naiwa figures in pale headwear watch a distant pair against a red ground.
description.zh: 戴浅色头巾的奶蛙们在红色地面场景中观看远处的一对角色。

description.en: Four Naiwa figures hold one red line while standing or sitting on separate platforms.
description.zh: 四只奶蛙在分开的平台上站着或坐着，共同拿着一根红线。

description.en: Naiwa holds one fist near its body and reaches an open hand toward the viewer.
description.zh: 奶蛙一手握拳靠近身体，另一只手掌伸向观众。

description.en: A small Naiwa looks downward with one hand at its chin above a caption that says, “Nice!”
description.zh: 小奶蛙低头把一只手放在下巴处，配有“奶思”文字。

description.en: Naiwa rests on its hands and knees with its mouth open in a broad smile.
description.zh: 奶蛙双手双膝着地，张嘴露出大大的笑容。

description.en: Naiwa crouches low, laughing with its hands on its belly above the caption, “Big sis, I fell down.”
description.zh: 奶蛙低低地蹲着，双手捧腹大笑，下方写着“姐姐我摔倒了”。

description.en: Naiwa stands with slumped shoulders, its head lowered and both arms hanging loosely.
description.zh: 奶蛙耷拉着肩膀站立，低着头，双臂松松垂下。

description.en: Naiwa lies on its front, props its smiling face in both hands, and raises both feet behind it.
description.zh: 奶蛙俯卧着，双手托起笑脸，双脚在身后翘起。

description.en: Naiwa holds an open dark book while a bright blue tear runs below one eye.
description.zh: 奶蛙捧着打开的深色书本，一只眼睛下面挂着亮蓝色眼泪。

description.en: Naiwa balances on one leg, kicks the other leg sideways, and raises both hands with its mouth open.
description.zh: 奶蛙单脚平衡，另一条腿侧向踢出，张嘴举起双手。

description.en: Naiwa stands in three-quarter view with its small hands held slightly in front of its belly.
description.zh: 奶蛙以四分之三侧面站立，小手微微抬在肚皮前。

title.en: Naiwa makes an intricate hand sign

description.en: Naiwa holds both hands prominently in front of its face and belly, with fingers pointing in different directions.
description.zh: 奶蛙把双手显眼地举在脸前与腹前，手指分别朝向不同方向。

description.en: A small rounded Naiwa leans sideways with both hands raised over its head.
description.zh: 小小的圆润奶蛙侧倾身体，双手举过头顶。

description.en: A close-up Naiwa has half-lidded green eyes and a small downturned mouth.
description.zh: 奶蛙特写中，绿色眼睛半垂着，小嘴向下弯。

description.en: A close-up Naiwa faces forward with wide green-ringed eyes and a small relaxed smile.
description.zh: 奶蛙正面特写睁着大大的绿色眼圈，轻松地露出浅浅微笑。

description.en: A laughing Naiwa kicks a smaller yellow dragon away amid bright energy rings.
description.zh: 大笑的奶蛙踢飞较小的黄色奶龙，周围有明亮的能量光环。

description.en: Green-eyed Naiwa holds a rice box marked “Sichuan University group meal” and lifts food with chopsticks.
description.zh: 绿眼奶蛙端着标有“川大拼好饭”的饭盒，用筷子夹起食物。

description.en: Naiwa lies on its side next to spilled food; the caption says, “I got food poisoning.”
description.zh: 奶蛙侧躺在洒出的饭菜旁，画面写着“中毒了”。

description.en: Naiwa lies beside an overturned rice box and raises one thumb.
description.zh: 奶蛙躺在打翻的饭盒旁，竖起一根拇指。

title.en: Still giving the meal a thumbs-up

description.en: Naiwa lies beside a rice box with its thumb raised and the caption, “It is just so…” above it.
description.zh: 奶蛙在饭盒旁躺着点赞，上方写着“就很..”。

title.en: Naiwa laughing in a university shirt

description.en: Naiwa wears a red-and-white collared shirt with a circular emblem and laughs with both hands on its belly.
description.zh: 奶蛙穿着带圆形标识的红白翻领上衣，双手放在肚子上大笑。

description.en: A white recolored Naiwa has a halo and feathered wings, with hands held together above an angel-mode caption.
description.zh: 白色换色奶蛙戴着光环、长着羽翼，双手合十，下方是切换天使模式的文字。

description.en: A pink recolored Naiwa leans to one side with one hand behind its head above a mode-switch caption.
description.zh: 粉色换色奶蛙侧身摆姿势，一只手放在头后，下方有模式切换文字。

description.en: A blue recolored Naiwa faces forward with a pale belly above a melancholy-mode caption.
description.zh: 蓝色换色奶蛙正面站立，露出浅色肚皮，下方是忧郁模式文字。

description.en: Naiwa holds a black umbrella in a dark rainy street; the image carries a depressed-mode caption.
description.zh: 奶蛙在昏暗雨街举着黑伞，画面配有切换抑郁模式的文字。

description.en: A purple recolored Naiwa raises a jeweled metal glove above a Thanos-mode caption.
description.zh: 紫色换色奶蛙举起镶有宝石的金属手套，下方是灭霸模式文字。

description.en: A shiny purple Naiwa has bright glowing eyes and a pale belly above a godhood-mode caption.
description.zh: 有光泽的紫色奶蛙双眼发亮、肚皮浅白，下方写着切换为神格模式。

description.en: An orange-red Naiwa puffs its cheeks and presses its mouth shut above a holding-it-in caption.
description.zh: 橙红色奶蛙鼓着腮、紧闭嘴巴，下方写着切换为绷住模式。

description.en: A bright-green recolored Naiwa stands with a pale belly above a punning green-mode caption.
description.zh: 鲜绿色换色奶蛙露着浅色肚皮站立，下方有“蕉绿模式”的谐音文字。

description.en: A pale blue Naiwa wears curled hair, closes its eyes, and holds its hands together within a glowing aura.
description.zh: 淡蓝色奶蛙顶着卷曲发型、闭眼合十，身后有发光轮廓，下方是贤者模式文字。

description.en: A small Naiwa holds an egg-shaped yellow companion in one hand while facing the viewer.
description.zh: 小奶蛙面向观众，一只手捧着蛋形黄色伙伴。

description.en: Naiwa holds a small egg-shaped yellow companion and stretches its other hand toward the viewer.
description.zh: 奶蛙一手抱着小小的蛋形黄色伙伴，另一只手伸向观众。

title.zh: 奶蛋撞向镜头，奶蛙在后

description.en: An angry-looking Naiwa stands behind a yellow egg-shaped companion that appears to strike cracked glass.
description.zh: 表情生气的奶蛙站在后方，蛋形黄色伙伴冲向前景，周围呈现玻璃裂纹。

description.en: Several Naiwa characters stand in a line beside a white van; a caption runs across the bottom.
description.zh: 几只奶蛙在白色面包车旁排成一列，底部配有文字。

description.en: Naiwa balances upside down with one leg extended toward a pink heart at the upper right.
description.zh: 奶蛙倒立，一条腿伸向右上方的粉色爱心。

title.en: Feet up in a white chair

description.en: Naiwa reclines in a white chair with a large foot sole raised toward the viewer.
description.zh: 奶蛙靠坐在白色椅子里，向观众抬起一只大脚掌。

description.en: A golden Naiwa faces forward with large feathered wings extended on a dark background.
description.zh: 金色奶蛙正面面对观众，在深色背景上展开宽大的羽翼。

description.en: A very round fuzzy yellow Naiwa crouches close to the ground with large green-ringed eyes.
description.zh: 一只圆滚滚、毛绒绒的黄色小奶蛙贴地蹲着，长着大大的绿色眼圈。

title.en: Naiwa below a school of fish

description.en: A yellow Naiwa floats in dark blue water beneath a shimmering school of fish and shafts of light.
description.zh: 黄色奶蛙漂浮在深蓝水中，上方是闪亮鱼群和穿透水面的光束。

description.en: Naiwa sits in the front of a vehicle overflowing with colorful flowers.
description.zh: 奶蛙坐在车辆前部，车内挤满五颜六色的花朵。

description.en: Naiwa floats face-up in a dark pond surrounded by small flowers and circular ripples.
description.zh: 奶蛙仰面漂在深色池水中，周围有小花和圆形涟漪。

description.en: Naiwa stands in shallow blue seawater under a pale open sky.
description.zh: 奶蛙站在浅蓝海水中，头顶是开阔而浅淡的天空。

description.en: Seen from behind, Naiwa faces an orange sunset beside grass and utility poles.
description.zh: 背对观众的奶蛙面向橙色夕阳，旁边是草地和电线杆。

description.en: Naiwa wears an apron in a rustic kitchen lit by bright warm light from a window.
description.zh: 奶蛙系着围裙站在朴素厨房里，窗户透进明亮暖光。

title.zh: 被设备线缆围住的奶蛙

description.en: Naiwa lies among electronic devices and coiled black cables on a pale surface.
description.zh: 奶蛙躺在浅色平面上，周围散着电子设备和卷绕的黑色线缆。

title.en: Pop-art Naiwa bust with a magenta eye band
title.zh: 洋红遮眼条的波普风奶蛙半身像

description.en: A yellow Naiwa bust combines halftone dots, geometric stripes and cloud-pattern insets; its green eyes are partly covered by a magenta bar.
description.zh: 黄色奶蛙半身像结合半色调圆点、几何条纹和云朵图案，绿色眼睛被洋红色横条部分遮住。

title.en: Naiwa curled on a swimming ring

description.en: From above, Naiwa curls up inside a yellow ring on bright blue pool water.
description.zh: 俯视画面中，奶蛙蜷在黄色泳圈里，下方是明亮蓝色泳池水。

description.en: Naiwa hangs near a high building balcony above a dense gray city.
description.zh: 奶蛙悬在高楼阳台附近，下方是密集的灰色城市。

title.en: Naiwa resting on a forest branch

description.en: Naiwa lies on a mossy branch in a dark forest with hanging vegetation.
description.zh: 奶蛙躺在黑暗森林里的覆苔枝条上，周围垂着植物。

description.en: Naiwa hangs head-down above a reflective surface beneath towering clouds.
description.zh: 奶蛙头朝下悬在反光水面上方，背景是高耸云层。

title.en: Naiwa on a balcony above the clouds

description.en: Naiwa sits on an orange chair on a small balcony surrounded by bright clouds.
description.zh: 奶蛙坐在小阳台的橙色椅子上，周围是明亮云团。

title.en: Naiwa above a rainy night street

description.en: Naiwa sits on a high ledge overlooking a dark city street and illuminated signs.
description.zh: 奶蛙坐在高处边缘，俯望昏暗城市街道和发光招牌。

description.en: A small Naiwa sits on a ledge overlooking broken gray towers in mist.
description.zh: 一只小奶蛙坐在高处边缘，俯望雾中的破败灰色高楼。

title.en: Naiwa in a blue underwater room
title.zh: 蓝色水下房间里的奶蛙

description.en: Naiwa sits inside a deep-blue room with a glowing jellyfish visible beyond a large window.
description.zh: 奶蛙坐在深蓝色房间里，宽大窗户外可见发光水母。

title.en: Naiwa and fish in a shaft of light

description.en: Naiwa floats among fish in a dark chamber illuminated by a vertical beam of light.
description.zh: 奶蛙与鱼群一起漂在黑暗空间中，一束竖直光柱照亮它们。

description.en: Naiwa sits in a dark stairwell below a window filled with bright clouds.
description.zh: 奶蛙坐在昏暗楼梯间里，上方窗口映着明亮云团。

title.en: A hidden Naiwa in tall reeds

description.en: A small yellow Naiwa peers from dense dark reeds while a pale figure occupies the foreground.
description.zh: 小小的黄色奶蛙从密集深色芦苇里探出脸，前景有一块浅色身影。

description.en: A seated Naiwa dissolves into glossy multicolored drips against a dark purple background.
description.zh: 坐着的奶蛙在深紫背景前化成闪亮的多彩流滴。

description.en: Naiwa lies on its back in a bright green field, its pale belly facing upward.
description.zh: 奶蛙仰面躺在鲜绿草地上，浅色肚皮朝着天空。

title.en: Naiwa drifting through a blue sky

description.en: A yellow Naiwa floats horizontally in a clear blue sky above small white clouds.
description.zh: 黄色奶蛙横向漂在清澈蓝天中，下方是小小白云。

description.en: Naiwa crouches at the base of a weathered green wall with vines and soft light.
description.zh: 奶蛙蹲在斑驳绿色墙壁底部，周围有藤蔓和柔和光线。

title.en: Naiwa on a foggy concrete balcony

description.en: A small Naiwa sits on a protruding concrete balcony of a weathered building in gray fog.
description.zh: 小奶蛙坐在旧楼凸出的水泥阳台上，周围笼罩灰雾。

description.en: Two Naiwa figures embrace in a pale sculptural scene, one with large feathered wings.
description.zh: 两只奶蛙在浅色雕塑风格场景中相拥，其中一只长着宽大羽翼。

description.en: Robe-clad Naiwa figures gather around a raised reclining figure in a dark classical interior.
description.zh: 穿长袍的奶蛙们在昏暗古典室内围着一位半躺的人物聚集。

description.en: Many Naiwa figures crowd a wooden raft on stormy seas beneath dramatic clouds.
description.zh: 许多奶蛙挤在风浪中的木筏上，天空云层翻涌。

description.en: Naiwa figures in robes gather around a blazing altar under a dramatic sky.
description.zh: 穿长袍的奶蛙们聚在燃烧的祭坛周围，天空十分浓烈。

description.en: A reclining Naiwa reaches toward a robed figure surrounded by other Naiwa figures in a fresco-like composition.
description.zh: 横卧的奶蛙伸手靠近一位被其他奶蛙围绕的长袍人物，构图带有壁画风格。

description.en: A uniformed mounted Naiwa gestures amid cavalry and soldiers in a broad battle scene.
description.zh: 穿军服骑马的奶蛙在宽阔战场上做出手势，周围是骑兵和士兵。

description.en: A luminous elevated Naiwa appears above a crowd of robed figures in a dramatic religious-painting composition.
description.zh: 发光的奶蛙升在一群长袍人物上方，构图模仿戏剧性的宗教绘画。

description.en: Naiwa figures gather around a table as a narrow shaft of light enters a dark room.
description.zh: 奶蛙们围坐桌旁，一束细光照进昏暗房间。

description.en: Naiwa figures and a horse occupy a dramatic scene with a fallen figure and a bright diagonal light.
description.zh: 奶蛙们与一匹马出现在戏剧性场景里，地面有人物倒下，斜向亮光照来。

description.en: A blue-robed figure cradles a reclining Naiwa amid small winged figures and warm clouds.
description.zh: 蓝袍人物怀抱横卧的奶蛙，周围是小小的有翼人物和暖色云层。

title.zh: 奶蛙在塔楼阶梯上的会面

description.en: Two clothed Naiwa figures meet on stone steps inside a shadowed tower.
description.zh: 两只穿衣奶蛙在昏暗塔楼内的石阶上相遇。

description.en: A glowing Naiwa rises above figures below, framed by a bright circular halo and red cloth.
description.zh: 发光奶蛙在下方人物之上升起，身后有明亮圆形光环和红色布料。

description.en: A crowd of Naiwa figures in dark historical clothing assembles in a dimly lit hall.
description.zh: 一群穿深色历史服饰的奶蛙聚在光线昏暗的大厅中。

description.en: An armored winged Naiwa dominates a stormy composition above struggling figures.
description.zh: 披甲有翼奶蛙占据风暴般的画面中央，下方有挣扎的人物。

description.en: A winged figure descends through bright clouds toward a kneeling Naiwa in flowing robes.
description.zh: 有翼人物穿过明亮云层降下，靠近一只穿飘逸长袍、跪着的奶蛙。

title.en: Four Naiwa riders of the apocalypse

description.en: Four mounted Naiwa figures ride across a dark dramatic landscape under turbulent clouds.
description.zh: 四位骑马奶蛙穿过浓烈的暗色景观，上方云层翻涌。

description.en: Robe-clad Naiwa figures gesture around a fallen central figure in a monumental stone hall.
description.zh: 穿袍奶蛙们在宏伟石厅里围着倒地的中央人物做出手势。

description.en: A small Naiwa sits at a desk with papers in a dark study, casting a large shadow.
description.zh: 小奶蛙坐在暗色书房的书桌前，桌上有纸张，墙上投出巨大影子。

description.en: Uniformed Naiwa figures stand together in a smoky open battlefield scene.
description.zh: 穿军服的奶蛙们聚在一起，身处烟雾弥漫的开阔战场。

description.en: An elaborate ceremony fills a grand cathedral with richly dressed Naiwa figures.
description.zh: 华丽仪式在宏大教堂内展开，许多奶蛙身着繁复服饰。

title.en: The birth of the Naiwa ruler

description.en: A prominently posed Naiwa wears an ornate red-and-gold outfit against a dramatic landscape.
description.zh: 一只姿态醒目的奶蛙身穿红金色华丽服饰，背景是浓烈景观。

title.zh: 奶破蛙翻越阿尔卑斯山

description.en: A red-caped Naiwa rides a rearing pale horse through a rugged mountain pass.
description.zh: 披红斗篷的奶蛙骑着前蹄扬起的浅色马穿行崎岖山口。

description.en: A robed Naiwa stands before towering parted waters and a procession under a shaft of light.
description.zh: 长袍奶蛙站在高高分开的水墙前，后方有队伍，天空落下光柱。

description.en: Uniformed Naiwa figures assemble in a gilded ceremonial hall beneath tall windows.
description.zh: 穿军服的奶蛙们聚在镀金仪式大厅里，上方是高大的窗户。

description.en: Two Naiwa figures embrace while seated on a swing in a lush green garden.
description.zh: 两只奶蛙相拥坐在秋千上，周围是浓密绿园。

description.en: Two groups of historical-costume Naiwa figures meet beside a horse and many upright spears.
description.zh: 两群穿历史服饰的奶蛙在一匹马与许多直立长矛旁会面。

description.en: A Naiwa in a pale flowing dress holds a green parasol on a grassy slope beneath blue sky.
description.zh: 穿浅色飘逸裙子的奶蛙站在蓝天下的草坡上，撑着绿色阳伞。

description.en: Many Naiwa figures sit along one side of a long table in a symmetrical dining hall.
description.zh: 许多奶蛙沿长餐桌的一侧坐着，餐厅构图左右对称。

description.en: Small Naiwa figures travel through a vast warm-toned landscape toward a bright distant opening.
description.zh: 小小的奶蛙们穿过广阔暖色景观，向远处明亮开口前进。

description.en: A Naiwa in a pale dress sits on grass under leafy trees with a broad white skirt spread around it.
description.zh: 穿浅色裙子的奶蛙坐在树荫下草地上，宽大的白裙铺在身旁。

description.en: Naiwa figures crowd a small boat amid water and ice, with one figure standing near a flag.
description.zh: 奶蛙们挤在水面与浮冰间的小船上，其中一位在旗帜附近站立。

description.en: Robe-clad Naiwa figures gather around a reclining Naiwa on a dark shoreline.
description.zh: 穿袍奶蛙们在昏暗海岸围着一只横卧的奶蛙。

description.en: A pale Naiwa in flowing fabric arches backward while another dark-clad figure stands nearby.
description.zh: 穿飘逸浅色布料的奶蛙向后仰身，旁边站着另一位深色衣装人物。

description.en: A flag-bearing Naiwa leads a dense crowd across a smoky scene of rubble and fallen figures.
description.zh: 举旗的奶蛙带领密集人群越过烟雾、碎石和倒地人物。

description.en: Two Naiwa figures sit closely together on a tree branch in a lush, softly lit woodland.
description.zh: 两只奶蛙紧挨着坐在树枝上，周围是柔光照亮的茂密林地。

description.en: A clothed Naiwa pulls another figure forward through a lush garden in flowing fabric.
description.zh: 穿衣奶蛙拉着另一位人物穿过茂密花园，衣料向后飘起。

title.zh: 阿齐姆与泽莉卡奶蛙版

description.en: Two Naiwa figures embrace on the ground amid distant flames, one wrapped in red cloth and the other in white.
description.zh: 两只奶蛙在远处火光映照下于地面相拥，一只裹红布，一只穿白衣。

title.en: Ivan Naiwa and the fallen dragon

description.en: A Naiwa in dark red robes cradles a fallen yellow figure in a dim richly furnished room.
description.zh: 深红长袍奶蛙在昏暗而陈设华丽的房间里抱着倒下的黄色人物。

title.en: Naiwa in a suit at night

description.en: Naiwa wears a dark suit and tie with a brightly lit city skyline behind it.
description.zh: 奶蛙穿深色西装、打领带，身后是灯光明亮的城市天际线。

description.en: Naiwa wears headphones and holds a transparent umbrella under a streetlamp on a gray rainy night.
description.zh: 奶蛙戴着耳机，在灰暗雨夜的路灯下撑着透明雨伞。

description.en: A pale-bellied Naiwa sits in shadow with one arm resting beside a softly lit window.
description.zh: 浅色肚皮的奶蛙坐在阴影里，一条手臂靠在柔光窗边。

title.en: Naiwa with a leaf collar and staff

description.en: Naiwa wears a green leaf collar and head decoration while holding a wooden staff topped with a red ornament.
description.zh: 奶蛙戴绿色叶领和头饰，手持顶端有红色装饰的木杖。

title.en: Naiwa makes a point in a suit

description.en: Naiwa in a dark suit and red tie raises one index finger while its other arm crosses its body.
description.zh: 深色西装、红领带的奶蛙竖起一根食指，另一条手臂横放身前。

description.en: A tall Naiwa in a dark suit and red tie holds one hand at the front of its jacket.
description.zh: 修长奶蛙穿着深色西装与红领带，一只手放在外套前襟。

title.en: Naiwa folds its arms in a suit

description.en: Naiwa stands with folded arms in a dark suit, white shirt, and red tie.
description.zh: 奶蛙穿深色西装、白衬衫、红领带，抱着双臂站立。

title.en: Naiwa with a parasol in a painted landscape

description.en: A painterly Naiwa in a pale blue dress stands beneath a green parasol, with another small yellow figure below.
description.zh: 绘画风格的奶蛙穿浅蓝裙、撑绿伞站立，下方还有一个较小的黄色人物。

description.en: A green-eyed Naiwa in a dark dress sits with folded hands before a hazy landscape.
description.zh: 绿眼奶蛙穿深色裙装，双手交叠坐在朦胧风景前。

title.en: Naiwa in the bath with a letter

description.en: A slumped Naiwa reclines in a bath holding a sheet of paper beside a wooden box and green cloth.
description.zh: 奶蛙无力地靠在浴缸里拿着一张纸，旁边有木箱和绿色布料。

description.en: Naiwa presses its hands to its face beneath a red swirling sky in an expressive painted scene.
description.zh: 奶蛙在红色旋涡般的天空下双手贴脸，画面带有强烈绘画笔触。

description.en: A Naiwa in a long green dress stands among dense plants and hanging blossoms.
description.zh: 穿绿色长裙的奶蛙站在浓密植物与垂落花朵之间。

description.en: A Naiwa in a blue-and-gold headscarf turns toward the viewer with a bright pearl earring.
description.zh: 戴蓝金色头巾的奶蛙转头望向观众，耳旁挂着明亮珍珠耳环。

description.en: Many robed Naiwa figures gather on broad steps beneath monumental classical arches.
description.zh: 许多长袍奶蛙聚在宽阔台阶上，头顶是宏大的古典拱顶。

title.en: Naiwa diners at a long table

description.en: A row of Naiwa figures shares a meal along one side of a long white-covered table in a vaulted room.
description.zh: 一排奶蛙在拱顶房间里沿白布长桌一侧共进晚餐。

title.zh: 小凳上张臂抬腿的奶蛙

description.en: Naiwa sits on a small round stool with both arms and both legs lifted outward.
description.zh: 奶蛙坐在小圆凳上，双臂与双腿都向外抬起。

description.en: A small green-eyed Naiwa peeks from a cracked white eggshell among shell fragments.
description.zh: 一只绿眼小奶蛙从裂开的白色蛋壳里探出身子，周围散着碎壳。

description.en: Several small yellow Naiwa hatchlings sit among eggshells and straw in a warmly lit nest.
description.zh: 几只黄色小奶蛙坐在暖光照亮的窝里，周围是蛋壳与稻草。

description.en: Naiwa spreads white feathered wings and raises one hand while stepping forward.
description.zh: 奶蛙展开白色羽翼，一边迈步一边举起一只手。

description.en: Yellow Naiwa faces replace sunflower centers in a painted vase of flowers.
description.zh: 一瓶绘画风格向日葵中，黄色奶蛙的脸取代了花盘。

description.en: A line of Naiwa figures pulls ropes along a sandy riverbank with a boat behind them.
description.zh: 一列奶蛙在沙质河岸上拉着绳索，后方停着船。

title.en: The birth of Venus as Naiwa

description.en: A yellow Naiwa stands on a shell near the shore, framed by floating figures and a robed attendant.
description.zh: 黄色奶蛙站在海岸边的贝壳上，旁边有飘浮人物与穿袍侍者。

description.en: Seen mostly from behind, a round yellow Naiwa floats upward amid a radiant golden glow.
description.zh: 圆润黄色奶蛙主要以背影呈现，在灿烂金光中向上漂浮。

description.en: Naiwa sits in a wide-legged pose wearing red high-heeled shoes.
description.zh: 奶蛙穿红色高跟鞋，以双腿分开的姿势坐着。

title.en: Naiwa in a red ornamental outfit

description.en: Naiwa wears an elaborate red outfit and dark curled hair, lifting both hands beside its head with its tongue out.
description.zh: 奶蛙穿繁复红装、顶着深色卷发，双手举在头旁并伸出舌头。

description.en: A giant stone Naiwa-headed sphinx sits in a desert with pyramids behind it.
description.zh: 巨大的石质奶蛙头狮身像坐在沙漠中，背后是金字塔。

title.en: Painted Naiwa with a laurel wreath

description.en: A textured painted side-profile Naiwa wears a leaf wreath against a blue background.
description.zh: 带肌理的绘画中，侧面奶蛙戴着叶冠，身后是蓝色背景。

description.en: Naiwa holds its hands together at its chest with white feathered wings behind its shoulders.
description.zh: 奶蛙在胸前双手合十，肩后展开白色羽翼。

description.en: Naiwa figures in ornate ceremonial clothing fill a grand interior around a seated central figure.
description.zh: 奶蛙们身穿华丽礼服，在宏大室内围着一位坐着的中央人物聚集。

title.en: Illustrated Naiwa with a red scarf

description.en: A flat illustrated Naiwa portrait has long brown hair, green eyes, and a bright red scarf.
description.zh: 平面插画中的奶蛙留着棕色长发、长着绿眼睛，围着鲜红围巾。

title.en: Naiwa in a comic conversation circle

description.en: Several hand-drawn yellow Naiwa figures sit facing one another and gesture in conversation.
description.zh: 几只手绘黄色奶蛙相对围坐，边交谈边做手势。

description.en: A red apple carries Naiwa's green-ringed eyes and small smile.
description.zh: 一颗红苹果上长着奶蛙的绿色眼圈和小小笑嘴。

title.en: Naiwa shaped like the letter B

description.en: A yellow letter B has a Naiwa face near the top and folded arms across its middle.
description.zh: 黄色字母B顶部带有奶蛙的脸，中部横着一双抱起的手臂。

description.en: Naiwa sits at a desk reading a book whose cover shows another yellow character.
description.zh: 奶蛙坐在桌边看书，书封面上画着另一个黄色角色。

description.en: A downcast Naiwa wears a red strawberry-shaped cap with pale seeds and a green leafy top.
description.zh: 表情低落的奶蛙戴着红色草莓形帽子，上面有浅色种子点和绿色叶顶。

description.en: Naiwa wears a light blue police-style shirt and dark cap, standing with arms crossed.
description.zh: 奶蛙穿浅蓝色警服样式衬衫、戴深色帽子，抱臂站立。

title.en: Naiwa shaped like the numeral one

description.en: A yellow numeral one has Naiwa's face, pale belly, and folded arms.
description.zh: 黄色数字1带有奶蛙的脸、浅色肚皮和交叠的双臂。

title.en: Two Naiwa beside an alpine lake

description.en: Two Naiwa characters stand close together beside a blue lake ringed by snowy mountains.
description.zh: 两只奶蛙紧挨着站在蓝色湖边，周围是积雪山峰。

title.en: Faceted angel Naiwa with a tear

description.en: A yellow low-poly Naiwa has a thin halo overhead and one long tear beneath an eye.
description.zh: 黄色低多边形奶蛙头顶细光环，一只眼睛下面垂着长长的泪滴。

description.en: Two Naiwa characters sit beside a classroom window, turn toward each other, and move from laughter to puffed-cheek restraint.
description.zh: 两只奶蛙坐在教室窗边，相互转头，从大笑变成鼓腮憋笑。

description.en: Naiwa gestures with both arms on grass beneath trees under a red caption calling the Naiwa family. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙站在树下草地上挥动双臂，下方红底配字“呼叫奶家人”。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: In this GIF, Naiwa tilts its head, changes its expression and raises a finger beside its temple. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 动图中，奶蛙歪头变换表情，并举起一根手指指向太阳穴旁。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Pink Naiwa in a rainbow helmet

description.en: A pink Naiwa variant wearing a rainbow-colored helmet turns its head and opens its mouth in front of a white fence. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 粉色奶蛙戴着彩虹色头盔，在白色围栏前转头并张嘴。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa alternates steps and bends its knees while dancing between bookshelves and standing lamps. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙在书架和落地灯之间交替迈步、弯膝跳舞。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa swimming with a sea-creature tail

description.en: A yellow Naiwa variant with small flippers and a split tail swims upright beneath a bright blue water surface. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 黄色奶蛙变体长着小鳍肢和分叉尾巴，在明亮的蓝色水面下直立游动。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Colored gourds transforming into laughing Naiwa
title.zh: 彩色葫芦变成大笑奶蛙

description.en: Hanging colored gourds transform into Naiwa figures; yellow and other colored Naiwa laugh together outdoors among mountains. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 悬挂的彩色葫芦变成奶蛙，黄色及其他颜色的奶蛙在山间户外一起大笑。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa dancing beside a white long-eared companion
title.zh: 奶蛙与白色长耳同伴跳舞

description.en: Naiwa and a white long-eared round companion sway and move their arms together before ornate stained-glass windows. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙和白色长耳圆胖同伴在华丽的彩绘玻璃窗前一起摇摆、挥动手臂。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa dancing with a long-eared companion in a living room
title.zh: 奶蛙与长耳同伴在客厅跳舞

description.en: Naiwa and a pale long-eared companion sway side to side and move their arms in a softly lit living room. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙与浅色长耳同伴在柔和灯光的客厅中左右摇摆、挥动手臂。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa swings its arms overhead and dances; the GIF cuts from a bright yellow scene to an orange-tinted version of the performance. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙把双臂举过头顶挥动跳舞，动图从明亮黄色场景切换到橙色调舞动画面。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Leather-jacket Naiwa and a mouse in green fumes
title.zh: 皮夹克奶蛙与绿烟中的老鼠

description.en: A leather-jacketed Naiwa turns away from a small mouse; a green cloud then covers the mouse, which becomes dark-faced and distressed. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 穿皮夹克的奶蛙转身背对小老鼠，随后绿烟罩住老鼠，老鼠脸色变黑并露出难受表情。保留公开展示的水印。

title.zh: 两只奶蛙在床上比手势

description.en: Two Naiwa sit closely together beneath a pale blanket, smiling and moving their hands. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 两只奶蛙紧挨着坐在浅色被子下，微笑着挥动双手。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa turning a walk into high kicks
title.zh: 奶蛙走着走着抬腿踢起

description.en: Naiwa walks in profile, then raises its knees and kicks a leg high while balancing with its arms. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙侧身走路，随后抬膝、高高踢起一条腿，并用双臂保持平衡。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa covering its mouth at a doorway

description.en: Naiwa stands at a decorated doorway, repeatedly lifting both hands toward its mouth while stepping closer to the camera. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙站在装饰丰富的门前，反复把双手抬到嘴边，并迈步靠近镜头。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa leaving its prison stripes behind
title.zh: 奶蛙脱下囚服迎向阳光

description.en: In a stormy scene, Naiwa pulls at its striped prison outfit, appears without it and opens its arms toward a break of golden sunlight. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 风雨场景中，奶蛙拉扯条纹囚服，随后脱离囚服，向穿过乌云的金色阳光展开双臂。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa holding a rose in a stormy fantasy scene
title.zh: 风雨奇幻场景中奶蛙拿玫瑰

description.en: Naiwa stands on a high stone structure in a stormy scene with sweeping white fabric; the view cuts closer as it holds a red rose near its face. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 风雨场景里，奶蛙站在高高的石建筑上，白色布料掠过；随后镜头拉近，奶蛙把红玫瑰举到脸旁。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Angel Naiwa opening its praying hands
title.zh: 天使奶蛙展开合十的双手

description.en: Naiwa has white wings and a golden halo; it opens and closes its hands in a gentle praying gesture. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙带着白色翅膀和金色光环，轻轻展开再合拢双手，做出祈祷动作。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa repeatedly hops and spreads its arms, smiling widely in a pale, uncluttered setting. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 浅色简洁背景中，奶蛙反复蹦跳、展开双臂，露出大大的笑容。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa clutching its head in a dark corner

description.en: Naiwa sits in a dark corner, grips both sides of its head and lowers its tearful face. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙坐在阴暗角落，双手抱住头的两侧，低下含泪的脸。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa falling off a bicycle on a road
title.zh: 奶蛙骑车在公路上摔倒

description.en: Naiwa rides a bicycle along a country road, loses balance and falls onto the asphalt with the bicycle. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙沿乡间公路骑自行车，随后失去平衡，连人带车摔到柏油路上。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa dancing in a night-time square

description.en: Naiwa swings its arms and steps around in a paved square with brightly illuminated golden buildings behind it. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙在铺砖广场上挥臂迈步，身后是灯光明亮的金色建筑。保留公开展示的水印。

title.zh: 奶蛙穿紫色珠宝装跳舞

description.en: Naiwa dances in an ornate purple-and-gold jeweled outfit, moving its arms and hips against a bright fantasy-city backdrop. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙穿华丽的紫金色珠宝装，在明亮的奇幻城市背景前挥动双臂、扭动身体跳舞。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa holding an open purple folding phone
title.zh: 奶蛙双手拿紫色折叠手机

description.en: Naiwa holds a wide, open purple folding phone with both hands and looks down at it. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙双手拿着展开的宽幅紫色折叠手机，低头看向手机。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa looking at a gold-and-black phone

description.en: Naiwa holds a gold-and-black phone with a prominent round camera, touching its chin with the other hand. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙拿着金黑色、带大圆形摄像头的手机，另一只手摸着下巴。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa thinking over a pale-blue phone
title.zh: 奶蛙托腮看浅蓝色手机

description.en: Naiwa studies a pale-blue phone with a clustered set of camera lenses while resting a hand beneath its chin. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙拿着浅蓝色、带一组摄像镜头的手机，一只手托着下巴端详。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa treating a brick like a phone

description.en: Naiwa holds a reddish brick upright like a phone and touches its chin thoughtfully. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙把红褐色砖块竖着拿在手中，像看手机一样托腮思考。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa looking at a white phone with a horizontal camera
title.zh: 奶蛙看横条镜头白色手机

description.en: Naiwa holds a white phone with a black horizontal camera module, resting the other hand beneath its chin. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙拿着带黑色横条摄像头的白色手机，另一只手托着下巴。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa looking at a white round-camera phone
title.zh: 奶蛙看圆形镜头白色手机

description.en: Naiwa touches its chin while holding a pale phone with a large round black camera module. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙摸着下巴，手拿浅色手机，背面有一个大黑色圆形摄像头。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa holding an open white folding phone
title.zh: 奶蛙拿展开的白色折叠手机

description.en: Naiwa holds a wide white folding phone with both hands; one panel shows a dark circular screen pattern. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙双手拿展开的白色折叠手机，其中一侧面板可见深色圆形屏幕图案。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa holds a black phone upright and rests its other hand under its chin against a white background. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 白色背景上，奶蛙竖着拿黑色手机，另一只手托着下巴。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Two Naiwa figures stand facing each other; the left one bends forward and extends its tongue to the other’s outstretched hand. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 两只奶蛙相对站立，左边的奶蛙俯身伸出舌头，舔右边同伴伸出的手。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa licking a seated companion’s foot
title.zh: 奶蛙舔坐着的同伴的脚

description.en: One Naiwa crouches and extends its tongue toward the foot of another Naiwa sitting with legs forward. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 一只奶蛙蹲下伸出舌头，舔另一只双腿前伸、坐着的奶蛙的脚。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa licking a companion’s raised foot

description.en: The left Naiwa bends down to lick the raised foot of a second Naiwa standing on one leg. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 左边奶蛙俯身舔右边奶蛙抬起的脚，右边奶蛙单腿站立。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A green-striped watermelon version of Naiwa sits on a plate, with a curling vine and two pink peach-like lobes behind it. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 西瓜条纹的奶蛙坐在盘子上，头上有卷曲藤蔓，身后有两瓣粉色桃子状造型。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa thinking over a white phone

description.en: Naiwa holds a white phone upright and rests its other hand under its chin. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙竖着拿白色手机，另一只手托着下巴。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa wears an old-fashioned dark robe, a tied-up hairstyle and a long black beard in a painted portrait. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 绘画风肖像中，奶蛙穿深色古装长袍、束起头发，留着长黑胡子。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa lifting a foot toward its face

description.en: Naiwa bends forward on one leg and holds its lifted foot close to its face. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙单腿站立向前弯腰，捧起另一只脚凑近脸。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa in a suit reading with crossed legs

description.en: A Naiwa-headed figure wears a dark suit, white shirt and dark stockings while reading a book in a wheeled office chair with legs crossed. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙头的角色穿深色西装、白衬衫和深色丝袜，翘腿坐在办公转椅上读书。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa looks sideways with half-lidded eyes beneath a clear, close-fitting hood with a small tip at the top. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙戴着顶部有小尖端的透明贴头头套，半眯着眼睛看向一旁。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A cat-eared Naiwa variant puffs its cheeks and raises a paw with visible pink pads. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 猫耳造型的奶蛙鼓着脸颊，举起一只露出粉色肉垫的爪子。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Rabbit-eared Naiwa posing with a raised leg

description.en: Naiwa has long rabbit ears and a fluffy tail, lifting one leg sideways while placing one hand behind its head. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙长着长兔耳和毛绒尾巴，一条腿向侧面抬高，一只手放在脑后。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A yellow chicken-shaped Naiwa variant has green eyes, a red comb and an upright fan of tail feathers. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 黄色小鸡造型的奶蛙有绿色眼睛、红色鸡冠和竖起的扇形尾羽。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa wears a spiky durian-shell hat and gives a half-lidded, downturned-mouth look. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙戴着带尖刺的榴莲壳帽子，半眯眼睛、嘴角下撇。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa wears a white shirt, green waist wrap and dark trousers with three swords positioned behind its shoulder. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙穿白色上衣、绿色腰带和深色裤子，肩后背着三把剑。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Red Naiwa soldier with folded arms

description.en: A red Naiwa variant with green eyes wears camouflage uniform, cap and tactical vest, standing with arms folded. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 红色、绿眼睛的奶蛙穿迷彩制服、帽子和战术背心，双臂交叉站立。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa leans forward in a wide stance while holding and aiming a long red rifle. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙双腿分开、身体前倾，双手举着红色长步枪瞄准。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa in a blue superhero suit and red cape

description.en: Naiwa wears a dark-blue superhero suit, a red cape and boots, and gold shoulder details while its round pale belly remains visible. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙穿深蓝色超级英雄战衣、红披风和靴子，肩部有金色装饰，圆圆的浅色肚皮露在外面。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa in glasses, waistcoat and tie
title.zh: 奶蛙戴眼镜穿马甲领带

description.en: Naiwa wears rectangular glasses, a blue waistcoat over a white shirt and a tie, with an oversized weapon behind its back. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙戴方框眼镜，白衬衫外穿蓝色马甲、系领带，背后有一把大型武器。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Blond Naiwa in an American-flag outfit
title.zh: 金发奶蛙穿美国旗图案服装

description.en: A blond-haired Naiwa variant stands with folded arms wearing red-and-white stripes and a blue panel of white stars. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 金发奶蛙变体双臂交叉站立，身穿红白条纹和蓝底白星图案服装。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A heavily muscular yellow Naiwa folds one arm and rests the other hand against its chin. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 肌肉发达的黄色奶蛙一臂横抱，另一只手托着下巴。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A small, round Naiwa wears a blue police uniform, a dark peaked cap and a utility belt, with arms folded. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 圆胖的Q版奶蛙穿蓝色警服，戴深色大檐帽和装备腰带，双臂交叉。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Pink Naiwa wearing a large flower

description.en: A pink Naiwa variant rests its hands on a tabletop, wearing a large pink flower and puffing its cheeks. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 粉色奶蛙戴着一朵大粉花，双手放在桌面上，鼓着脸颊。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa face on a swoosh shape

description.en: Naiwa’s green-eyed face is incorporated into a long yellow swoosh-shaped graphic. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙的绿眼睛脸被融入一条长长的黄色勾形图案。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Bowl-cut Naiwa in a school uniform

description.en: Naiwa wears a black bowl-cut hairstyle and a blue-and-white school uniform while a hand points toward it. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙留着黑色锅盖头，穿蓝白校服，一只手正指向它。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Blond Naiwa laughing in a black shirt
title.zh: 金发奶蛙穿黑衬衫大笑

description.en: A blond-haired Naiwa wears a black collared shirt with a small American flag patch and laughs with both hands on its belly. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 金发奶蛙穿带小美国旗贴章的黑色有领衬衫，双手捂着肚子大笑。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa’s green-eyed head rises from an elongated hand-shaped body with rounded finger-like tips. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙绿眼睛的头从细长的手掌形身体上立起，前端带有圆润的手指状结构。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa in a dark police uniform

description.en: Naiwa wears a dark-blue police uniform and peaked cap, folding its arms and narrowing its green eyes. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙穿深蓝色警服、戴大檐帽，双臂交叉并眯起绿色眼睛。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A round yellow fish-shaped Naiwa has large green eyes, scales, fins and a fan-shaped tail. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 圆圆的黄色小鱼造型奶蛙长着绿色大眼睛、鱼鳞、鱼鳍和扇形尾巴。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Pink-eared Naiwa reclining with puffed cheeks

description.en: A pink-eared Naiwa variant reclines on one side, props its head on a hand and puffs its rosy cheeks. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 带粉色小耳朵的奶蛙侧躺着，一只手托头，鼓起红扑扑的脸颊。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa bending beside an open toilet
title.zh: 奶蛙在打开的马桶旁弯腰

description.en: Naiwa bends sideways beside an open toilet, with a thin yellow stream arcing toward the bowl. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙在打开的马桶旁侧身弯腰，一条细黄色水流弧线朝向马桶。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa holds a black telephone receiver to its ear, with red decline and green answer buttons beneath it. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙把黑色电话听筒举到耳边，下方有红色拒接和绿色接听按钮。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Chibi Naiwa in a dark ninja outfit

description.en: A round chibi Naiwa wears dark ninja-style clothing, arm guards and a scarf, with swords behind its back and arms folded. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 圆胖的Q版奶蛙穿深色忍者风服装、护臂和围巾，背后有剑，双臂交叉。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa squatting in red high heels

description.en: An exaggerated long-limbed Naiwa spreads its arms and squats with legs wide while wearing red high heels. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 四肢夸张拉长的奶蛙张开双臂、双腿大开蹲下，脚穿红色高跟鞋。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa with a mohawk and black tank top

description.en: Naiwa wears a black tank top and tall dark mohawk, sitting at a table with a metal bowl and chopsticks. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙留着高高的深色莫西干发型、穿黑背心，坐在摆着金属碗和筷子的桌前。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa standing with hands on hips

description.en: Naiwa stands facing forward with both hands on its hips and its pale belly visible. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙正面站立、双手叉腰，露出浅色肚皮。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A side-facing close-up of Naiwa has a caption meaning “two striking glances.” The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙侧脸特写下方配有中文“惊鸿两瞥”。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A close-up shows Naiwa with very large green eyes and a slightly open mouth against a dark background. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 深色背景下，奶蛙特写中绿色眼睛睁得很大，嘴微微张开。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A frontal close-up of Naiwa shows large green eyes and a small open mouth. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙正面特写露出绿色大眼睛和微微张开的小嘴。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa looking back with one leg lifted

description.en: Naiwa looks back over its shoulder with a small smile while lifting one bent leg. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙微笑着回头看，抬起一条弯曲的腿。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa spreads its legs wide, raises one arm diagonally and places the other hand beside its head. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙双腿大幅张开，一只手斜向上伸直，另一只手放在头侧。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa glancing sideways in a classroom

description.en: A close crop shows Naiwa in a white garment looking sideways, with a classroom wall and poster behind it. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 特写中，穿白色衣服的奶蛙看向侧面，身后是教室墙壁和海报。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa’s blank look in a library
title.zh: 奶蛙在图书馆面无表情

description.en: Naiwa stands before bookshelves with nearly closed eyes and a small downturned mouth. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙站在书架前，眼睛几乎闭着，小嘴向下撇。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa looking back while bent forward

description.en: Naiwa bends forward with its back toward the viewer and turns its green-eyed face back with a smile. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙背对观众弯腰，微笑着转回绿眼睛的脸。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa lying down with both feet raised

description.en: Naiwa reclines on its back with both feet raised and one hand bracing against the ground. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙仰躺着抬起双脚，一只手撑在地面上。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A round-bellied Naiwa stands facing forward with its arms folded over its upper belly. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 圆肚子的奶蛙正面站立，双臂交叉放在肚子上方。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A side-facing portrait shows Naiwa with a half-lidded eye and a small straight mouth. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 侧脸肖像中的奶蛙半眯着眼睛，嘴巴抿成小小的一条线。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A close-up shows Naiwa tilting its head down, eyelids lowered and mouth downturned. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 特写中，奶蛙低着头、垂着眼皮，嘴角下撇。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: One Naiwa hugging another from behind

description.en: A larger Naiwa embraces a smaller laughing Naiwa from behind; both have closed eyes and happy expressions. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 较大的奶蛙从背后抱住较小、正在大笑的奶蛙，两只都闭着眼睛，表情开心。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa’s lowered eyes and open mouth

description.en: Naiwa looks downward with drooping eyelids and a small open mouth against a dark background. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 深色背景下，奶蛙眼皮下垂地看向下方，嘴微微张开。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A small round Naiwa looks forward and presses one finger beside its nose. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 圆胖的Q版奶蛙面向前方，一根手指贴在鼻子旁。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Two small yellow Naiwa embrace face to face and touch their puckered lips together. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 两只黄色Q版奶蛙面对面拥抱，撅起的嘴唇贴在一起。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa laughing with its tongue out

description.en: A close, tilted view shows Naiwa laughing with eyes closed, mouth wide open and tongue extended. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 倾斜的近景中，奶蛙闭眼张大嘴巴大笑，伸出舌头。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Chibi Naiwa standing with folded arms

description.en: A small, round Naiwa faces forward and folds its arms beneath a slight smile. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 圆胖的Q版奶蛙面向前方，微微笑着，双臂交叉。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa: I will never laugh again

description.en: A grayscale Naiwa gives an unhappy sideways look above a red caption meaning “I will never laugh again…” The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 灰度奶蛙不开心地看向一旁，下方红底配字“我再也不会笑了…”。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa leaning into a companion’s belly

description.en: One Naiwa bends forward and nestles its head against the belly of another standing Naiwa. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 一只奶蛙弯下身，把头靠在另一只站着的奶蛙肚子上。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa laughing with both hands on its belly

description.en: Naiwa laughs with its head raised, eyes closed and both dark hands pressed to its belly. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙仰头闭眼大笑，两只深色的手按在肚子上。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A close-up shows Naiwa looking sideways with heavy eyelids and a pronounced downturned mouth. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 特写中，奶蛙眼皮低垂地看向一旁，嘴角明显下撇。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa bending and sticking out its tongue

description.en: Naiwa bends its knees and holds its belly while laughing with its tongue extended. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙屈膝捧着肚子大笑，同时伸出舌头。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa holding its belly with a worried look
title.zh: 奶蛙捧肚子露出担心表情

description.en: Naiwa looks downward with drooping eyelids and holds both hands together over its belly. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙垂着眼皮向下看，双手合拢放在肚子前。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa’s upside-down face between its legs
title.zh: 奶蛙从双腿间露出倒着的脸

description.en: Naiwa bends fully over, showing its upside-down green-eyed face between its feet. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙深深弯下腰，从双脚之间露出倒着的绿眼睛脸。保留公开展示的水印。

title.zh: 奶蛙张大嘴巴狂笑特写

description.en: An extreme close-up shows Naiwa’s wide open laughing mouth, teeth and closed smiling eyes. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 极近特写展示奶蛙大张的笑嘴、牙齿和闭起的笑眼。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa making two peace signs over its head

description.en: Naiwa raises both hands over its head in peace signs and sticks out its tongue. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙把双手举到头顶比剪刀手，同时吐出舌头。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa brings one arm to its face as several large tears run beneath its green eye. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙把一条手臂举到脸前，绿色眼睛下方流着几滴大眼泪。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa curled up: protection from being eaten

description.en: Naiwa curls into a round shape with hands by its head; a white caption on its body means “protection from being eaten.” The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙蜷成圆团，双手放在头边，身体上有白字“防吃”。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A frontal close-up shows Naiwa’s large green eyes filled with tears and its small mouth turned down. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 正面特写中，奶蛙绿色大眼睛含满泪水，小嘴向下撇。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa watching rain through a window

description.en: Naiwa sits alone beside a rain-streaked window in a dim room, with one hand resting near the windowsill. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 昏暗房间里，奶蛙独自坐在布满雨痕的窗边，一只手放在窗台附近。保留公开展示的水印。

title.zh: 奶蛙摸头安慰难过的同伴

description.en: A taller Naiwa rests its hand on the head of a smaller, downcast Naiwa beside it. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 较高的奶蛙把手放在旁边较小、垂头丧气的奶蛙头上。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa picks up a brown coiled object
title.zh: 奶蛙捡起棕色卷状物的恶搞

description.en: Naiwa laughs while holding its belly, then bends down to pick up a brown coiled object at its feet, brings it to its mouth in an eating gesture, and laughs again. The complete public GIF and watermark are preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙先捂肚子大笑，脚边出现棕色卷状物；它弯腰捡起该物，送到嘴边作进食动作，随后再次大笑。保留完整公开 GIF 及水印。

title.en: Naiwa boxing: If you laughed, take your beating
title.zh: 奶蛙打拳：没绷住的自觉挨打

description.en: Naiwa throws punches outdoors beneath a Chinese caption meaning “If you couldn't keep it together, take your beating,” joking that anyone who failed to keep a straight face should take their beating. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙在户外挥拳，顶部配字“没绷住的自觉挨打”，用玩笑口吻调侃忍不住笑的人。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Lotus-leaf Naiwa startled in the water

description.en: A green Naiwa beneath a broad lotus-leaf hat floats in blue water, then opens its mouth and raises both hands to its head in surprise. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 绿色奶蛙顶着宽大的荷叶帽浮在蓝色水中，随后惊讶地张嘴、双手举到头旁。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Laughing Naiwa multiplying around a manhole
title.zh: 井盖旁不断出现的大笑奶蛙

description.en: A Naiwa stands by a manhole on a sunny road; more Naiwa tumble into view until a crowd gathers and laughs together. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 晴天公路的井盖旁站着一只奶蛙，随后更多奶蛙翻滚进入画面，最后聚成一群一起大笑。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa strolling and dancing at sunset
title.zh: 奶蛙在日落街头边走边跳

description.en: Naiwa swings its arms and takes playful steps along a city sidewalk lit by warm sunset light. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙在温暖日落光线照着的城市人行道上挥动手臂，迈着俏皮步子。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa crouches by a gray wall, turns its face back toward the viewer and gently shifts its rounded body. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙在灰墙旁蹲着，回头看向观众，圆圆的身体轻轻晃动。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa dancing in a pink rabbit outfit
title.zh: 奶蛙穿粉色兔子服跳舞

description.en: Naiwa wears a pink-and-yellow frilled rabbit-themed outfit in a classroom, tilting its head and moving its hands; a small control meter appears in the corner. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙在教室里穿粉黄相间的花边兔子主题服装，歪头并挥动双手，角落里有一个小控制仪表图案。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa juggling stones on a bottle cap
title.zh: 奶蛙站在瓶盖上抛石头

description.en: Naiwa balances on a blue bottle cap with an orange fruit on its head while tossing stones between its hands. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙头顶一个橙色水果，站在蓝色瓶盖上保持平衡，双手来回抛接石头。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa dancing in a colorful fantasy courtyard
title.zh: 奶蛙在彩色奇幻庭院跳舞

description.en: Naiwa sways and alternates hand gestures in a richly colored courtyard with water, tall structures and hanging pink plants. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙在色彩丰富的庭院里摇摆、交替比画手势，周围有水面、高大建筑和垂挂的粉色植物。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A low-angle close-up of Naiwa shifts from a wide-eyed stare to a closed-eye, open-mouthed laugh. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 低角度的奶蛙特写从睁眼凝视变成闭眼张嘴大笑。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa dancing in a red-and-white frilled dress
title.zh: 奶蛙穿红白花边裙跳舞

description.en: Naiwa wears a red-and-white tiered frilled dress and matching bonnet, moving its hands and head in a pink decorated room. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙穿红白相间的多层花边裙、戴配套软帽，在粉色装饰房间里挥手、晃头。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A close-up shows Naiwa wearing a dark bowl-cut hairstyle, turning its head and smiling with half-lidded green eyes. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 特写中，奶蛙留着深色锅盖头，转动脑袋，半眯着绿色眼睛微笑。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Curly-haired Naiwa blowing a kiss in a pink suit
title.zh: 卷发奶蛙穿粉西装飞吻

description.en: Naiwa wears dark curly hair and a pale pink suit, brings a hand to its mouth and reaches toward the viewer as pink hearts float around it. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙留深色卷发、穿浅粉西装，一只手举到嘴边后朝观众伸出，周围飘着粉色爱心。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa repeatedly throws its head back in a wide-mouthed laugh while another yellow figure is visible behind it. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 近景中，奶蛙反复仰头张嘴大笑，身后还能看到另一个黄色角色。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa slowly smiling toward the viewer

description.en: A small Naiwa figure against a pale background subtly changes its expression before the view moves closer to its smiling face. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 浅色背景上的小奶蛙微微变换表情，随后画面靠近它的笑脸。保留公开展示的水印。

title.zh: 奶蛙在青山前比画手势

description.en: Naiwa clasps its hands, touches its chin and raises one arm in front of tall green mountains. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 高高的青山前，奶蛙先合拢双手，再托腮、举起一条手臂。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa dancing in a crown and red robe

description.en: Naiwa wears a pointed crown and red patterned robe, moving from palms together into playful dance gestures. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙戴尖冠、披红色花纹袍子，从双手合十转为俏皮的舞蹈动作。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa laughing and turning away indoors

description.en: Naiwa laughs with both hands on its belly in a warm-lit room, then rotates its body away from the viewer. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 暖色灯光的房间中，奶蛙双手捧腹大笑，随后转身背向观众。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Helmeted pink Naiwa popping up and yawning
title.zh: 粉色头盔奶蛙冒头打哈欠

description.en: Pink Naiwa rises into view on grass before a white fence wearing a rainbow helmet, stretches its arms, opens its mouth in a yawn and brings a hand over its mouth. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 粉色奶蛙戴彩虹头盔，从白色围栏前的草地上冒出，伸展双臂、张嘴打哈欠，随后用手捂嘴。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa looks downward with inward-sloping eyelids and a downturned mouth in a dim indoor setting. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 昏暗室内，奶蛙垂眼向下看，眼皮向内倾斜，嘴角下撇。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Chibi Naiwa pointing at its cheeks

description.en: A round chibi Naiwa raises both hands to its cheeks and gives a small smile. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 圆胖的Q版奶蛙把双手举到脸颊旁，露出小小的微笑。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A close crop of Naiwa’s green-eyed head shows a small smile as it faces to the side. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙绿眼睛头部的近景中，它面向侧面，露出小小的笑容。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa licking its own foot close-up

description.en: Naiwa holds a dark foot beside its smiling face and extends its tongue toward the toes. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙把一只深色脚掌拿到笑脸旁，伸出舌头舔向脚趾。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa holds a white food tub and lifts noodles to its mouth with chopsticks. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙捧着白色餐盒，用筷子把面条夹到嘴边。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa covering its mouth with teary eyes

description.en: Naiwa covers its mouth with one dark hand while tears gather beneath its wide green eyes. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙用一只深色手掌捂着嘴，睁大的绿色眼睛下聚着眼泪。保留公开展示的水印。

title.zh: 奶蛙展示画出来的腹肌

description.en: Naiwa holds a stick behind its shoulders beside a window; black lines drawn on its belly imitate abdominal muscles. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 窗边，奶蛙把木棍扛在肩后，肚皮上的黑色线条模仿腹肌。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa rests a hand under its chin above a red caption reading “Thinking in progress,” a playful Chinese-English mix. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙一只手托着下巴，下方红底配字“思考ing”，表示正在思考。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A close-up shows Naiwa with huge green eyes and a very wide, rounded open mouth. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙特写中，绿色大眼睛睁得很大，嘴张成一个大圆形。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A close frontal view shows Naiwa smiling broadly with its tongue sticking out. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 正面近景中，奶蛙大大地笑着，舌头伸在嘴外。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa sits on a wooden surface wearing a pink strawberry-patterned bib, with rosy puffed cheeks and narrowed eyes. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙坐在木面上，戴粉色草莓图案围兜，红扑扑的脸颊鼓起，眼睛眯着。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa in the driver’s seat of a luxury car
title.zh: 奶蛙坐在豪华轿车驾驶座

description.en: Naiwa sits in a tan driver’s seat inside a black car with its door open. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 黑色轿车车门敞开，奶蛙坐在棕黄色驾驶座上。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: A van full of chibi Naiwa

description.en: Several small Naiwa figures emerge from a white van beneath a caption meaning “I'll bring a vanload of Nailong to deal with you.” The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 几只Q版奶蛙从白色面包车里出来，下方配字“找一车奶龙弄你”。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa wears dark curly hair and round glasses, holding two fingers upright beside its face and pointing the other hand down. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙留着深色卷发、戴圆框眼镜，脸旁竖起两根手指，另一只手向下指。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa putting its foot in its mouth

description.en: Naiwa balances on one leg while lifting the other foot into its open mouth. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙单腿站立，把另一只脚抬到张开的嘴里。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa wrapped as a leaf dumpling

description.en: Naiwa is wrapped in green leaves tied with string, forming a zongzi-like triangular bundle with its head and pale belly visible. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙被绿色叶子包裹、用绳子系住，形成粽子状三角包，头和浅色肚皮露在外面。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa sits on a white toilet, resting one hand under its chin and folding the other arm across its belly. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙坐在白色马桶上，一只手托着下巴，另一条手臂横放在肚子前。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa smiling with a long tongue

description.en: Naiwa faces slightly sideways with a wide smile and a long pink tongue hanging out. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙略微侧身，大大地笑着，嘴外垂着一条长长的粉色舌头。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa in a Girl with a Pearl Earring parody
title.zh: 戴珍珠耳环少女风奶蛙

description.en: Naiwa appears as a painted portrait wearing a blue-and-gold head wrap and brown clothing, looking back over its shoulder. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 绘画风的奶蛙戴蓝金色头巾、穿棕色衣服，回头望向肩后，模仿《戴珍珠耳环的少女》构图。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa on all fours under a question mark
title.zh: 奶蛙四肢着地顶着问号

description.en: Naiwa stands on all fours and stares forward beneath a red square containing a white question mark. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙四肢着地凝视前方，头上方是红底白色问号方块。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Three Naiwa form a group portrait: the center one folds its arms, the right one touches its chin and the left one looks on. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 三只奶蛙组成合照，中间一只抱臂，右边一只托腮，左边一只在旁观看。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Chibi Naiwa: Did my wealth bother you?

description.en: A broad, squat chibi Naiwa stands above a red caption asking, “Did my wealth get to you?” The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 宽胖的Q版奶蛙站在红底配字“豪到你了？”上方。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa laughing at a phone in bed
title.zh: 奶蛙在被窝里看手机大笑

description.en: Naiwa lies beneath white bedding, holding a dark smartphone and laughing with its eyes closed. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙躺在白色被子下，手拿深色手机，闭眼大笑。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa resting its face in both hands

description.en: Naiwa tilts its head and rests both cheeks in its dark hands with a small smile. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙歪着头，双手托住脸颊，露出小小的笑容。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa touches its forehead with one hand while folding the other arm across its belly and smiling slightly. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙一只手摸着额头，另一条手臂横放在肚子前，微微笑着。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa tilts its head, holds both cheeks and smiles, with faint pink blush beneath its green eyes. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙歪头、双手托腮并微笑，绿色眼睛下方带淡淡粉色红晕。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Chibi Naiwa in a frilled skirt

description.en: A chibi Naiwa wears a pale frilled skirt, raises its hands to its cheeks and smiles with pink blush. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: Q版奶蛙穿浅色花边裙，双手举到脸颊旁，泛着粉色红晕微笑。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa wearing a plush dog hat

description.en: Naiwa wears a beige dog-faced hat with floppy ears and puffs its rosy cheeks with an unimpressed expression. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙戴米色狗脸垂耳帽，鼓着红扑扑的脸颊，表情不以为然。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Two Naiwa in an ink-painting composition
title.zh: 水墨构图中的两只奶蛙

description.en: An ink-painting-style composition places a laughing Naiwa beside a second Naiwa with folded arms on an ornamental stone setting. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 水墨画风构图中，一只大笑的奶蛙坐在旁边，另一只抱臂奶蛙位于装饰性石景上。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa looking back with a blush

description.en: Naiwa turns its head back in an indoor kitchen-like setting, with pink cheeks, wide green eyes and an open mouth. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 厨房状的室内场景中，奶蛙回过头，脸颊泛粉、绿眼睁大，嘴张着。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa: As if you were worthy

description.en: Naiwa laughs and extends one hand outdoors beneath a mocking caption meaning “Who do you think you are?” The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙在户外大笑并伸出一只手，下方配有嘲讽语“就你也配”。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa tilting its head with two peace signs

description.en: Naiwa tilts its head far to one side, sticks out its tongue and raises both hands in peace signs. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙把头大幅歪向一旁，吐出舌头，双手举起比剪刀手。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa wears an orange-peel cap topped with a green leaf and gives a downturned-mouth, half-lidded look. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙戴着顶部有绿叶的橘子皮帽，半眯眼睛、嘴角下撇。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A low-resolution close-up shows Naiwa squinting and pulling its mouth into a wide, tense grimace. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 低分辨率近景中，奶蛙眯起眼睛，嘴巴横向绷开，露出夸张的难受表情。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Chibi Naiwa: Are you mad, little bro?

description.en: Chibi Naiwa touches its nose above a red caption asking, “Are you mad, little bro?” The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: Q版奶蛙摸着鼻子，下方红底配字“气不气小弟弟”，以调侃口吻问对方是否生气。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa kneels with its head lowered and arms hanging loosely, giving a dejected expression. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙跪坐着低下头，双臂松松垂下，表情沮丧。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa as a monk with prayer beads

description.en: Naiwa wears orange-and-yellow monk-style robes and dark prayer beads, holding its hands together and bowing its head. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙穿橙黄色僧袍、戴深色佛珠，低头双手合十。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Bow-wearing Naiwa holding a no sign

description.en: A chibi Naiwa wears a large bow and frowns while holding a red circular sign with a white X. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: Q版奶蛙戴着大蝴蝶结，皱着脸举起红底白叉的圆形牌子。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa smugly smiling at a table

description.en: Naiwa rests its dark hands on a pale tabletop and smiles with puffed cheeks and nearly closed eyes against a blue background. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 蓝色背景下，奶蛙把深色双手放在浅色桌面上，鼓着脸颊、几乎闭眼地微笑。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Chibi Naiwa holding a clear spiked umbrella

description.en: A small Naiwa holds a blue-handled clear umbrella with pointed details around its edge. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 小小的奶蛙拿着蓝色手柄的透明伞，伞边缘有尖刺状装饰。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa with pink twin tails and a bow
title.zh: 奶蛙戴粉色双马尾和蝴蝶结

description.en: A chibi Naiwa wears a long pink twin-tailed hairstyle topped with a pale bow, while its green eyes remain visible. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: Q版奶蛙戴着长长的粉色双马尾，头顶有浅色蝴蝶结，绿色眼睛清晰可见。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa propping its face up with feet in the air

description.en: Naiwa lies forward with its face resting in both hands and both feet raised behind it. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙向前趴着，双手托住脸，双脚在身后翘起。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Pink Naiwa taking a mirror selfie

description.en: A pink Naiwa with green eyes holds a smartphone in front of a tiled bathroom mirror. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 粉色、绿眼睛的奶蛙在铺瓷砖的浴室镜子前拿着手机自拍。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Chibi Naiwa offering a small heart

description.en: A chibi Naiwa leans sideways and raises one hand with a small orange heart floating above it. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: Q版奶蛙侧倾身体并举起一只手，手上方浮着一颗小橙色爱心。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A small Naiwa bends its head and upper body forward, looking down with its arms held behind it. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 小奶蛙低下头、身体前倾，双臂放在身后，目光向下。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Chibi Naiwa sitting on a wooden stool

description.en: Naiwa sits on a small wooden stool with its short feet pointing forward and its eyes looking upward. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙坐在小木凳上，短短的双脚朝前伸，眼睛向上看。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A frontal close-up shows Naiwa’s bright green eyes and a broad toothy grin. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 正面近景中，奶蛙绿色眼睛明亮，嘴巴露齿大大地笑着。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa meditating: calm as still water

description.en: Naiwa sits cross-legged with closed eyes and hands on its knees above a caption meaning “A heart calm as still water.” The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙闭眼盘腿坐着，双手放在膝盖上，下方配字“心如止水”。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A Naiwa face with two small pink ears has rosy puffed cheeks and narrowed eyes. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 带两只粉色小耳朵的奶蛙脸鼓起红扑扑的脸颊，眼睛眯着。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa grinning with a hand beside its cheek

description.en: Naiwa raises a dark hand beside its cheek and gives a broad, toothy sideways grin. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙把一只深色手举在脸颊旁，朝侧面露出大大的牙齿笑容。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa holding its head with streaming tears
title.zh: 奶蛙抱头流下长长的眼泪

description.en: Naiwa presses both hands to its head, closes its green eyelids and sheds long streams of tears. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙双手按在头上，闭起绿色眼皮，流下长长的泪流。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Chibi Naiwa leaning far to one side

description.en: A round chibi Naiwa tilts its body sideways with one foot lifted and its arms held out for balance. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 圆胖的Q版奶蛙身体向一侧大幅倾斜，一只脚抬起，双臂伸出保持平衡。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa holding a torch and book atop a tall pedestal
title.zh: 奶蛙举火炬捧书站在高石台上

description.en: Against a blue sky, a giant statue-like Naiwa stands on a tall stone pedestal, raising a torch in one hand and holding a book in the other in a Statue of Liberty-inspired composition. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 蓝天下，巨大的奶蛙造型像雕像一样站在高石台上，一只手高举火炬，另一只手夹着书，构成自由女神像式的艺术画面。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa in profile with a question mark

description.en: Naiwa faces left in profile, with a red rounded-square badge containing a white question mark over its chest. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙侧身看向左侧，胸前叠着一个红色圆角方块，里面写着白色问号。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Illustrated Naiwa facing a blade across the foreground
title.zh: 绘画风奶蛙面对横过前景的刀刃

description.en: In a low-angle illustration, Naiwa has open round green eyes, a straight mouth, and tear marks beneath its eyes. A silver blade crosses the foreground just below its face against dark clouds. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 绘画风奶蛙以低角度呈现，圆绿眼睁开、嘴巴平直，眼下有泪痕；一把银色刀刃横过脸下方的前景，背后是暗色云层。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa in a lace helmet with wings and wheat
title.zh: 奶蛙戴蕾丝天使麦穗头盔

description.en: Rosy-cheeked Naiwa wears a white lace helmet decorated with small wings, golden wheat, pearls, and a Virgo symbol. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 泛红鼓腮的奶蛙戴着白色蕾丝头盔，帽上有小翅膀、金色麦穗、珍珠装饰及处女座符号。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa rides a yellow dog with reins

description.en: Naiwa straddles a long-eared yellow cartoon dog and holds rope-like reins in both hands as the dog stands against white. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙跨坐在一只长耳黄狗背上，双手拉着绳状缰绳，狗站在白色背景前。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: A saluting Naiwa figurine standing on a cutting mat
title.zh: 敬礼奶蛙小雕塑站在切割垫上

description.en: In a tabletop photograph-style scene, a small yellow Naiwa figurine stands on a gridded cutting mat with its round green eyes, flat mouth, and pale belly clearly visible. One hand rests at its temple, with a perforated panel behind it. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 桌面摄影风格画面中，一个黄色奶蛙小雕塑站在网格切割垫上，圆绿眼、扁嘴和奶白圆肚清楚可见，一只手举到太阳穴旁；背后是穿孔面板。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Emperor-costumed Naiwa raises a carved seal
title.zh: 帝王装奶蛙举起雕花印玺

description.en: Naiwa wears a black imperial crown with hanging beads and an ornate black-and-gold robe, frowning toward the viewer while presenting a pale square seal with carved decoration. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙戴带垂珠的黑色帝王冠、穿金黑纹饰长袍，皱眉看向镜头，并把一枚浅色方形雕花印玺举到前方。 保留公开展示水印。

description.en: Naiwa cradles a brown tabby cat whose white front paws rest on Naiwa's arms. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙用双臂抱住一只棕色虎斑猫，猫的白色前爪搭在奶蛙手臂上。 保留公开展示水印。

title.zh: 戴黑框眼镜鼓脸的奶蛙

description.en: Naiwa wears thick black-framed glasses, with puffed rosy cheeks and a tightly pursed mouth. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙戴着粗黑框眼镜，双颊鼓起且泛红，嘴巴紧抿着。 保留公开展示水印。

description.en: Three yellow Naiwa figures have bodies curved into the digit 6 and stand in a row to form 666, each with round green eyes and an open laughing mouth. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 三个黄色奶蛙的身体弯成数字6，依次排成666；每个角色都有绿色圆眼和张嘴笑脸。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa raising one finger in a red-and-black football shirt
title.zh: 奶蛙穿红黑球衣竖起一根手指

description.en: A short-black-haired Naiwa wears a red-and-black striped football shirt, smiles with its mouth open, and raises one finger beside its face. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 黑色短发的奶蛙穿红黑竖条纹足球衫，张嘴微笑，并在脸旁竖起一根手指。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa puffs its rosy cheeks under an egg-tart-shaped hat with a browned custard top and a flaky pastry rim. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙半眯眼鼓着红润脸颊，头顶一只带金黄焦斑和酥皮边的蛋挞形帽子。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Two Naiwa in a yellow convertible sports car
title.zh: 两只奶蛙乘黄色敞篷跑车

description.en: Two Naiwa sit in a yellow convertible sports car. The sunglasses-wearing one is behind the steering wheel while the passenger looks toward it. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 两只奶蛙坐在黄色敞篷跑车中，戴墨镜的一只坐在方向盘后，另一只看向它。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Sunglasses Naiwa riding a yellow scooter
title.zh: 墨镜奶蛙骑黄色踏板车

description.en: A sunglasses-wearing Naiwa grips the handlebars of a yellow scooter, with a second Naiwa partly visible behind the rider. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 戴墨镜的奶蛙骑在黄色踏板车上，双手握车把，后方坐着另一只部分可见的奶蛙。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Sunglasses Naiwa piloting a golden propeller plane
title.zh: 墨镜奶蛙驾驶金色螺旋桨飞机

description.en: A black-sunglasses-wearing Naiwa sits at the controls of a small golden propeller plane, with part of another Naiwa visible behind it. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 戴黑色墨镜的奶蛙坐在金色小飞机驾驶位，双手握住操纵把手，后排露出另一只奶蛙的一部分。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa with chin folds in bed

description.en: Naiwa reclines in bed with half-lidded green eyes, a downturned mouth and several soft folds beneath its chin. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙靠在床上，半垂着绿色眼睛，嘴角向下，下巴下方形成几层柔软褶皱。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: A delivery-box dog stands on Naiwa's back
title.zh: 背包黄狗站在奶蛙背上

description.en: A long-eared yellow cartoon dog carries a small orange box and stands on the back of an all-fours Naiwa whose round green eye and profile remain visible. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 一只长耳黄狗背着橙色小箱子，站在四肢着地的奶蛙背上；奶蛙的绿色圆眼和侧脸清晰可见。 保留公开展示水印。

title.zh: 奶蛙双手捧剥好的橘子

description.en: A chibi Naiwa holds a peeled mandarin up to its mouth with both hands and wide round eyes; white pith is visible on the segments. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: Q版奶蛙用双手把一个剥好皮的橘子举到嘴边，圆眼睁大，橘瓣上可见白色橘络。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa feeds a cat and pats its head

description.en: Naiwa bends toward a tabby cat on the ground and rests one hand on its head, with a small pile of food pellets in front of the cat. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙弯身看着地上的虎斑猫，把一只手放在猫头上，猫面前有一小堆颗粒状食物。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Sunglasses-wearing Naiwa on a tandem bicycle
title.zh: 墨镜奶蛙骑双人自行车

description.en: A Naiwa wearing black sunglasses sits at the front of a tandem bicycle and holds the handlebars, with part of a second Naiwa visible on the rear seat. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 戴黑色墨镜的奶蛙坐在双人自行车前座，握住车把；画面左侧还露出后座奶蛙的一部分。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa stands before a wind turbine

description.en: Naiwa stands on grass with its hands low beside its belly, with a tall wind turbine and blue sky behind it. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙站在草地上，双手垂放在肚子两侧，身后可见高高的风力发电机和蓝色天空。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Two puff-cheeked Naiwa grinning at classroom desks
title.zh: 两只鼓腮奶蛙在教室并桌坏笑

description.en: Two Naiwa sit behind adjacent green classroom desks by a window, puffing their cheeks and grinning toothily. One holds a hand near its chin while the other rests its hands beside a book. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 两只奶蛙坐在窗边相邻的绿色课桌后，鼓着脸颊露齿坏笑，一只手托近下巴，另一只把手放在书旁。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa staring displeased in side-parted brown hair and glasses
title.zh: 棕色侧分短发眼镜奶蛙不悦凝视

description.en: Naiwa wears short side-parted brown hair and black rectangular glasses, staring with half-lidded green eyes and a downturned mouth. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙戴棕色侧分短发和黑色方框眼镜，半垂着绿眼，嘴角向下，神情不悦。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: A chibi Naiwa sits curled up with its arms around its knees, looking down through green eyes with a downturned mouth. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: Q版奶蛙缩坐着抱住膝盖，绿色眼睛向下看，嘴巴下弯，显得很委屈。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa scrunches its eyes and blushes

description.en: Naiwa has rosy cheeks and eyes drawn as sharply angled closed lines, with its mouth held in a small smile. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙脸颊泛红，两只眼睛画成尖角折线，嘴巴保持细小微笑。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa reclines on a sofa with a phone

description.en: Naiwa reclines on a cream sofa with crossed legs, holding a black phone in one hand and resting the other beside its body. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙斜躺在米白色沙发上，双腿交叠，一只手举着黑色手机，另一只手撑在身旁。 保留公开展示水印。

description.en: Naiwa has heavy-lidded green eyes, pink cheeks and a small round pursed mouth, with bright window-side greenery behind it. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙的绿色眼睛半睁半闭，双颊粉红，嘴巴缩成一个小圆孔，背景是明亮的窗边绿植。 保留公开展示水印。

description.en: A smooth, egg-shaped Nai Dan has round green eyes and a small smile above a red caption reading “Serious face.” The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 圆润的奶蛋睁着绿色圆眼、嘴角微微上扬，下方红色横条写着“严肃脸。”。 保留公开展示水印。

description.en: Naiwa holds a large pink heart in both hands, with round green eyes and a gentle smile. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙用双手抱着一颗大大的粉色爱心，露出绿色圆眼和温和微笑。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa raises a stocking-clad leg while seated
title.zh: 黑丝袜奶蛙坐地高抬腿
