description.en: Naiwa sits on the ground wearing black stockings and raises one leg straight up, resting one hand on its head and the other on its leg while winking with its tongue out. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙穿黑色丝袜坐在地上，一条腿向上伸直，一只手扶头，另一只手放在腿上；它眨眼吐舌头。 保留公开展示水印。

title.zh: 奶蛙被绳子捆住：赎金1元

description.en: Rosy-cheeked Naiwa kneels with thick rope wrapped around its body and legs. A red banner in front reads “Ransom: one yuan.” The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 鼓着红脸颊的奶蛙跪坐着，粗绳围住身体与腿部，身前红底白字写着“赎金1元”。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa kneeling in the rain with a hand on its chest
title.zh: 奶蛙雨中跪地扶胸落泪

description.en: Naiwa kneels on wet ground with one hand bracing against the surface and the other pressed to its chest, lowering its head as tears run from its drooping eyes. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙在湿漉漉的地面上跪下，一只手撑地，另一只手按着胸口，低头垂眼流泪。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa has dark-brown bangs and two low pigtails, with lightly blushing cheeks, half-lidded green eyes looking aside, and a small flat smile. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙留着深棕色刘海和两条低马尾，双颊微红，半垂的绿眼看向一侧，扁平小嘴带着微笑。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Rosy-cheeked Naiwa in a banana-peel hat

description.en: Naiwa puffs its rosy cheeks beneath a banana-peel hat whose long flaps hang down on either side. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙鼓着泛红的脸颊，头上扣着香蕉皮，长长的蕉皮垂到两侧。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa walking a yellow dog with a red collar
title.zh: 奶蛙牵着红项圈小黄狗

description.en: Naiwa stands sideways against a white background, holding a black leash attached to a small yellow dog wearing a red collar. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙在白色背景前侧身站立，手里握着黑色牵引绳，绳子的另一端连着戴红项圈的小黄狗。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Little Naiwa makes a peace sign with an ankle strap
title.zh: 戴脚踝扣带比耶的小奶蛙

description.en: A chibi Naiwa tilts its head with a smile and raises a V sign, wearing a black buckled strap around one ankle. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: Q版奶蛙歪头微笑、抬手比V字，一只脚踝上戴着黑色扣带。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Puffy-cheeked Naiwa with a pink bow

description.en: Naiwa wears a pink bow and puffs its rosy cheeks, narrowing its eyes and pursing its mouth against a pink background. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙头戴粉色蝴蝶结，鼓起泛红的双颊、眯眼抿嘴，背景也呈粉色。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Two Naiwa figures hug and laugh
title.zh: 两只奶蛙搂在一起大笑

description.en: Two Naiwa figures hug closely from the side with their faces near each other, both laughing with closed eyes and open mouths. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 两只奶蛙侧身紧紧拥抱，脸靠得很近，都眯着眼睛张嘴大笑。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa kneels with joined palms and looks upward

description.en: Naiwa kneels with its palms pressed together at its chest, lifting its head and looking upward through round green eyes with a slightly downturned mouth. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙跪在地上，将双掌合在胸前，抬起头用绿色圆眼望向上方，嘴角微微下弯。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa sits at the wheel of a black-and-silver car
title.zh: 奶蛙坐在黑银轿车驾驶位

description.en: Naiwa sits in the driver's seat of a black-and-silver sedan, its round eyes and hands visible through the windshield beneath a dark glass roof. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙坐在黑银双色轿车的驾驶位，透过前挡风玻璃可见它的圆眼和双手，车顶带有深色天窗。 保留公开展示水印。

title.zh: 圆奶蛙戴墨镜举手招呼

description.en: A small round Naiwa wears dark round sunglasses, smiles slightly, and lifts one hand beside its body as if greeting someone. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 小圆奶蛙戴着深色圆墨镜，嘴角微微上扬，一只手举到身侧，像在打招呼。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa looks back: Are you annoyed, young lady?
title.zh: 回头奶蛙：气不气小妹妹

description.en: A chibi Naiwa turns to look back with a smile above a red caption asking, “Are you mad, little sis?” The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: Q版奶蛙侧背着身体回头微笑，红色横条配字为“气不气小妹妹”。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa sits with one leg raised vertically

description.en: Naiwa sits on a wooden floor with its hands braced at its sides, one leg raised vertically and the other folded in front. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙坐在木地板上，双手撑在身体两侧，一条腿竖直抬高，另一条腿弯在身前。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa takes a horse stance in red kung-fu clothes
title.zh: 红色功夫装奶蛙摆马步

description.en: Naiwa wears red Chinese-style kung-fu clothes and cloth shoes, with twin hair buns and a panda-face hair ornament, spreading its bent legs and raising its fists. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙穿红色中式功夫服和布鞋，扎着双丸子头并戴熊猫脸发饰，双腿分开屈膝、举起拳头。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa stands with a sword held horizontally

description.en: A painterly Naiwa stands with its legs apart and holds a long sword horizontally in front of its face, against a dark background with drifting white flecks and orange points of light. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 绘画风格的奶蛙双腿分开站立，一手将长刀横举在脸前；暗色背景中飘着白色碎屑和橙色光点。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Sunglasses Naiwa at handlebars in a yellow convertible
title.zh: 墨镜奶蛙用车把开黄色敞篷跑车

description.en: A sunglasses-wearing Naiwa sits in a yellow convertible sports car and holds protruding handlebar-like controls, while another Naiwa is partly visible on the left. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 墨镜奶蛙坐在黄色敞篷跑车里，双手握着突出的车把式控制杆，画面左侧露出另一只奶蛙。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa lies asleep on a white pillow with closed eyes and one small hand visible beside white and pale-blue bedding. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙侧躺在白色枕头上，闭着眼睛，一只手露在白色与浅蓝色床被边缘。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Blushing Naiwa kneels with joined palms

description.en: Naiwa kneels with both palms pressed together high in front of its chest, rosy cheeks, half-closed eyes and a pursed curved mouth. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙双膝跪地，把双手合在胸前偏上方，脸颊泛红、眼睛半眯，嘴巴抿成弧线。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Puffy-cheeked Naiwa with black hair and glasses

description.en: Naiwa wears short black hair and thick black-framed glasses, puffing its rosy cheeks and looking sideways with pursed lips. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙顶着黑色短发、戴粗黑框眼镜，双颊鼓起泛红，抿嘴看向一侧。 保留公开展示水印。

description.en: Naiwa retains round green eyes and a small smile, while its body becomes a yellow segmented worm shape trailing behind, with pale belly segments at the front. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙的头部保留绿色圆眼与细小微笑，下方身体变成拖向后方的黄色分节虫形，正面有浅色腹部条段。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa joins its palms in monk's robes

description.en: Naiwa stands facing forward in golden-yellow and reddish-brown monk's robes with prayer beads, pressing its palms together at chest level. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙穿着金黄色与赭红色僧袍、佩戴念珠，正面站立并将双掌合在胸前。 保留公开展示水印。

description.en: Naiwa wears a white sleeveless vest and faces the camera with round green eyes against a softly blurred green background. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙穿着白色无袖背心，露出绿色圆眼，面对镜头站在模糊的绿植背景前。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa and a yellow dog make peace signs

description.en: Naiwa stands behind a long-eared yellow cartoon dog, both with tongues out. Naiwa makes V signs above its head while the dog raises V signs beside its face. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙站在一只长耳黄狗后方，二者都吐着舌头；奶蛙在头顶比双手V字，黄狗在脸旁也举起V字手势。 保留公开展示水印。

description.en: Naiwa holds an open pale-beige Chinese-style paper parasol overhead, with its fine ribs and decorative pattern visible. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙一手举着浅米色中式纸伞，伞面展开在头顶，能看到细密伞骨与图案。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa with blunt bangs and puffed cheeks

description.en: Naiwa has dark-brown blunt bangs, half-closed eyes, and puffed orange-red cheeks. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙顶着深棕色齐刘海，半眯双眼，鼓起泛橙红色的脸颊。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Santa-hat Naiwa laughs with a companion
title.zh: 圣诞帽奶蛙和同伴大笑

description.en: A Naiwa in a red-and-white Santa hat laughs with its hands on its belly, while another Naiwa behind it throws its head back with both hands behind its head. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 前方奶蛙戴着红白圣诞帽、捂肚子笑，后方另一只奶蛙仰头大笑并把双手放在脑后。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa holding red roses amid pink hearts
title.zh: 奶蛙抱着红玫瑰和粉色爱心

description.en: A blushing Naiwa holds a large bouquet of red roses in both hands, partly hiding its face, while pink hearts float around it. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 脸颊泛红的奶蛙双手抱着一大束红玫瑰，花束遮住部分脸，周围飘着粉色爱心。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa wears a tall white chef's hat and a white chef jacket with black buttons and a golden M emblem, while resting one hand against its chin. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙戴白色高厨师帽，穿有黑色扣子及金色M标记的白色厨师服，一只手托着下巴。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa has brown pigtails and straight bangs, with puffed rosy cheeks, half-closed eyes and a pursed mouth. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙戴着棕色齐刘海双马尾发型，双颊鼓起泛红，半眯着眼睛抿嘴。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Puffy-cheeked Naiwa in a red worm-like form

description.en: Naiwa retains its familiar puffed rosy cheeks and pursed expression while its body takes a red segmented worm-like shape with short projections on top. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙保留熟悉的鼓红脸和抿嘴表情，身体变成红色分节虫形，头顶有短短的突起。 保留公开展示水印。

description.en: Naiwa sits on a white-and-black scooter with both hands on the handlebars and a black rear-view mirror on each side. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙坐在白黑配色的踏板车上，双手扶着车把，前方两侧各有一面黑色后视镜。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa laughs with a wide-open mouth and visible teeth, its eyes curved shut. A window and curtains are visible behind the close-up. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙在室内张大嘴露齿大笑，眼睛弯成两道弧线，身后可见窗户和窗帘。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa tears up while looking at a phone in bed

description.en: Naiwa lies on its side among pillows and bedding, holding a black phone in both hands with a tear beside one green eye and a slightly downturned mouth. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙侧躺在枕头与被子间，双手拿着黑色手机，一只绿色眼睛旁挂着泪水，嘴角微微下弯。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Two Naiwa figures hug and kiss

description.en: Two chibi Naiwa figures hug face to face, looking at each other with round green eyes as their small projecting pink-orange mouths touch. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 两只Q版奶蛙面对面拥抱，绿色圆眼看着对方，突出的粉橙色小嘴碰在一起。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Horse-bodied Naiwa lifting its front hooves

description.en: A yellow horse-bodied variant retains Naiwa's round green eyes and small flat mouth, with a flowing mane, tail, and black hooves, while lifting both front legs. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 黄色马身变体保留奶蛙圆绿眼和细小平嘴，长着飘动鬃毛、尾巴和黑色蹄子，双前腿抬起。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Pink Naiwa holding a long-barreled gun with a profane threat caption
title.zh: 粉色奶蛙持长枪配粗口威胁文字

description.en: A pink Naiwa smiles against a leafy background while holding a long-barreled gun across its body. The caption addresses Nai-shu with a profane threat to shoot the character’s mother. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 粉色奶蛙在绿树背景前微笑，双手横持带长圆枪管的枪械；下方配字对“奶鼠”发出枪杀其母亲的粗口威胁。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Five Naiwa figures sit cross-legged and shush

description.en: Five Naiwa figures sit cross-legged in a layered group, each holding one finger upright in front of its mouth in a shushing gesture. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 五只奶蛙前后排列、盘腿而坐，每只都竖起一根手指放在嘴前做“嘘”的动作。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Cat-eared Naiwa shows pink paw pads

description.en: Naiwa retains its round green eyes while sporting cat ears, sticking out its tongue and raising two dark cat paws with pink pads in front of its face. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙保留绿色圆眼，长着猫耳，吐着舌头，把两只带粉色肉垫的深色猫爪举到脸前。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Two Naiwa standing shoulder to shoulder
title.zh: 两只奶蛙并肩搭着肩膀

description.en: Against a black background, two Naiwa stand side by side, one resting a hand on the other's shoulder as they look at each other. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 黑色背景前，两只奶蛙并肩站立，一只把手搭在另一只的肩上，彼此相望。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa rests its hands on its hips and crosses its legs

description.en: Naiwa faces the viewer with its hands on its hips, its legs crossed and a small smile. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙双手叉腰、双腿交叉，正面朝向镜头露出小小的微笑。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa laughs at a phone while sitting on a bed
title.zh: 奶蛙坐床上看手机大笑

description.en: Naiwa sits on a bed holding a black phone in one hand and resting the other on its belly, laughing with closed eyes and an open mouth. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙坐在床上，一只手举着黑色手机，另一只手放在肚子上，眯着眼睛张嘴大笑。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa wearing a peeled banana on its head

description.en: A peeled banana sits on Naiwa's head, with yellow strips of peel hanging to either side above its half-lidded eyes. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙半垂着眼睛，一根剥开的香蕉扣在头顶，黄色蕉皮向两侧垂下。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Pink Naiwa holding a rifle with a profane threat caption
title.zh: 粉色奶蛙持步枪配粗口威胁文字

description.en: Against a leafy background, pink Naiwa holds a black rifle with a curved magazine, pointing toward the right side of the image. The caption addresses Nai-shu with a profane threat to shoot the character’s mother. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 粉色奶蛙在绿树背景前双手握着带弯曲弹匣的黑色步枪，枪口朝画面右侧；下方配字对“奶鼠”发出枪杀其母亲的粗口威胁。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Two little Naiwa figures hold hands

description.en: Two chibi Naiwa figures hold hands side by side; the one on the left lifts a leg, and both smile with round green eyes. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 两只Q版奶蛙并排牵手，左边一只抬起一条腿，两只都睁着绿色圆眼微笑。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: A yellow dog sits on a prone Naiwa
title.zh: 黄狗坐在趴着的奶蛙背上

description.en: Naiwa lies prone with its limbs tucked in and round green eyes looking forward, while a long-eared yellow cartoon dog sits upright on its back. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙四肢收拢趴在地上，绿色圆眼朝前看，一只长耳黄狗端坐在它背上。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa gestures behind a wooden lectern
title.zh: 木台后皱眉说话的奶蛙

description.en: Naiwa stands behind a wooden lectern with lowered brows and an open mouth, lifting a dark hand beside its cheek in an emphatic speaking gesture. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙站在木质台面后，皱着眉张嘴，一只深色手掌抬在脸颊旁，像在强调说话内容。 保留公开展示水印。

description.en: Naiwa wears voluminous side-swept black hair, with half-lidded green eyes and a downturned mouth. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙顶着蓬松的黑色侧分发型，半垂着绿色眼睛，嘴角向下，露出不高兴的神情。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa rests a hand on its belly: My tummy

description.en: Naiwa has rosy cheeks and rests one hand on its pale belly, with narrowed eyes and a pursed mouth. Red text at the right reads “My tummy,” in a playful, childlike phrasing. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙双颊泛红，一只手放在浅色肚子上，眯眼抿嘴；右侧红字写着“吾腹腹”。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa rests a closed hand against its chin

description.en: Naiwa sits in three-quarter view with a dark closed hand held beside its mouth and chin, its round green eyes looking ahead. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙侧身坐着，抬起一只深色拳头抵在嘴和下巴旁，绿色圆眼望向前方。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa crossing its arms in futuristic police gear
title.zh: 奶蛙穿未来警察装抱臂

description.en: Naiwa wears a navy police cap and bulky white-and-gray futuristic police gear with badges, shoulder patches, and a hose, while crossing its arms. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙戴深蓝色警帽，穿带有警徽、肩章和软管的白灰色厚重未来警察装，双臂交叉。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa hugging and patting a companion on the head
title.zh: 奶蛙拥抱并摸头安慰同伴

description.en: The Naiwa on the right smiles with closed eyes, rests one hand on its companion’s head, and wraps its other arm around the companion’s shoulders. The hugged Naiwa has downcast green eyes and looks unhappy. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 右侧奶蛙闭眼微笑，一只手抚着左侧同伴的头，另一条手臂环抱其肩膀；被抱的奶蛙低垂着绿色眼睛，显得不开心。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa reclines with one leg raised

description.en: Naiwa reclines on its side on a pale surface, resting one hand on its head and the other in front of its belly while extending one leg diagonally upward. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙侧躺在浅色地面上，一只手扶头、另一只手放在腹前，一条腿向斜上方伸直。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa reaches a large palm toward the camera
title.zh: 奶蛙向镜头伸出大手掌

description.en: Naiwa stands with its feet apart, extending an open dark palm toward the camera in exaggerated perspective while holding the other hand in a fist. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙张开腿站稳，将一只深色手掌向镜头伸出形成夸张透视，另一只手握拳收在身旁。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa bends toward its raised foot

description.en: Naiwa bends its elongated head down and smiles with its mouth close to the dark toes of a raised foot, with greenery behind it. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙弯低长长的头部，微笑着将嘴凑近抬起的深色脚趾，背景是户外绿植。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Helmeted Naiwa points at the viewer
title.zh: 戴黄头盔指向你的奶蛙

description.en: Naiwa wears a yellow helmet and a zipped yellow uniform with reflective strips, smiling and pointing a finger toward the viewer. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙戴着黄色头盔、穿着带反光条的黄色拉链制服，微笑着伸出一根手指指向镜头。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa in a white lace dress holding a rabbit plush
title.zh: 奶蛙穿白色蕾丝裙抱兔玩偶

description.en: A doll-like Naiwa in a layered white lace dress and white boots has long brown pigtails and cradles a white floppy-eared rabbit plush. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 娃娃式奶蛙穿白色层叠蕾丝裙和白靴，梳棕色双马尾，双臂抱着一只白色垂耳兔玩偶。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Sci-fi armored Naiwa in a ruined factory
title.zh: 废厂房里的科幻铠甲奶蛙

description.en: Naiwa wears a red-and-white metal helmet, chest armor with a glowing blue center and an ornate belt, reaching one hand forward in a ruined factory. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙戴红白金属头盔、穿带蓝色发光圆心的胸甲与装饰腰带，在破旧厂房里伸手摆出架势。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa in a black suit for a blue-background portrait
title.zh: 奶蛙穿黑西装拍蓝底证件照

description.en: Facing forward against a plain blue background, Naiwa wears a black suit, white shirt, and black tie with its round green eyes open and mouth held straight. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙正对镜头，穿黑色西装、白衬衫与黑领带，圆绿眼睁开、嘴巴平直，身后是纯蓝背景。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa wears a dark-blue police cap and light-blue uniform in a frontal bust portrait. A red badge bears “Nai-cop,” a wordplay combining Naiwa and police. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙戴着深蓝警帽、穿浅蓝制服，正面半身像前叠着红色方块，白字写“奶察”。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa crouches with its hands by its knees

description.en: In a cutout-style image, Naiwa crouches with its head lowered and dark hands beside its knees, looking down through round green eyes. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 抠图风格的奶蛙低头蹲坐着，两只深色手掌放在膝盖旁，绿色圆眼向下看。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa with crab legs and large pincers
title.zh: 奶蛙长出蟹腿和大蟹钳

description.en: Naiwa’s round green eyes, flat smiling mouth, and pale belly remain visible on its central body, while orange jointed crab legs extend to both sides and a pair of large pincers reaches forward. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙的圆绿眼、扁平笑嘴和奶白肚皮保留在中央身体上，两侧长出橙色分节蟹腿，前方伸着一对大蟹钳。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa carrying a staff in golden armor and a red cape
title.zh: 奶蛙穿金甲红披风扛长杖

description.en: A squat Naiwa wears a golden headband, ornate golden armor, and a red cape while carrying a long staff diagonally over one shoulder. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 矮胖奶蛙戴金箍，穿金色花纹盔甲和红色披风，一根长杖斜搭在肩上。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa with binoculars: Wow, a pretty woman!

description.en: Naiwa holds black binoculars whose lenses resemble large eyes, opening its mouth and sticking out its tongue above the caption “Wow! A pretty woman!” The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙举着黑色望远镜，镜片被画成大大的眼睛；它张嘴伸舌头，下方配字为“哇！有美女”。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: A ring of Naiwa heads around one round belly
title.zh: 一圈奶蛙小脑袋围着大肚子

description.en: Multiple Naiwa heads, each retaining round green eyes and a small flat mouth, form a ring around a single broad, pale-bellied body. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 一个奶蛙胖身躯周围排列着多个奶蛙脑袋，各自保留圆绿眼和扁平小嘴，形成多头构图。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa holds a yellow dog's ears while riding
title.zh: 奶蛙抓着狗耳朵骑黄狗

description.en: Naiwa sits on a long-eared yellow cartoon dog's back, leaning slightly forward with its hands at the ears on either side of the dog's head. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙坐在长耳黄狗背上，双手放在狗头两侧的耳朵附近，身体略向前倾。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa standing sideways and looking back

description.en: Seen from a rear-side angle, Naiwa looks back toward the viewer with its round green eyes. One hand hangs beside its hip, and both its rounded rump and pale belly are visible. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙以侧后方角度站立，圆绿眼朝镜头回望，一只手垂在腰臀旁，突出的圆臀和奶白肚皮同时可见。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa looks surprised and blushes in a kitchen
title.zh: 厨房里脸红惊讶的奶蛙

description.en: Naiwa looks back in front of kitchen cabinets with wide green eyes and an open mouth, with short red blush marks drawn on its cheeks. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙在厨房橱柜前回头，睁大绿色眼睛、张着嘴，脸颊上画有红色短线状腮红。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa stares blankly on all fours

description.en: Naiwa faces the viewer on all fours with dark palms planted on the ground, round green eyes open and its mouth in a short downturned line. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙正面朝向镜头四肢着地，深色手掌撑住地面，绿色圆眼睁大，嘴巴呈短短的下弯线。 保留公开展示水印。

description.en: A yellow snake-bodied variant with Naiwa's round green eyes and flat smile coils on the ground and touches its chin with a small dark hand. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 带有奶蛙圆绿眼和扁平笑嘴的黄色蛇身变体盘成一圈，用一只深色小手托着下巴。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Spiky-haired Naiwa sticking its tongue out in profile
title.zh: 奶蛙顶着刺猬头朝侧面吐舌

description.en: In right-facing profile, Naiwa has short spiky black hair, a wide-open round green eye, and a pink tongue sticking out. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙以侧脸朝向右边，黑色短发向上炸开，一只圆绿眼睁大，粉色舌头伸出嘴外。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Glasses-wearing Naiwa holding a phone indoors
title.zh: 戴眼镜的奶蛙在室内拿手机

description.en: Naiwa has wavy black hair, black-framed glasses, and a scarf, and wears a light knitted vest over a dark shirt while holding a phone indoors. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙梳黑色卷发、戴黑框眼镜和围巾，穿浅色针织背心与深色衬衫，在室内拿着手机。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa gives a sly sideways grin

description.en: Naiwa glances sideways indoors with half-lidded eyes and a stretched grin showing a row of teeth. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙在室内侧目，半眯着眼睛，嘴角拉开露出一排牙齿，神情像在偷笑。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Black-haired Naiwa glaring at a phone
title.zh: 黑发奶蛙气鼓鼓盯手机

description.en: Naiwa has swept black hair, puffed cheeks, and a furrowed brow as it glares at a phone on the right, with a white droplet hanging from its mouth. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙顶着偏向一侧的黑色头发，鼓着脸颊、皱眉盯住画面右侧的手机，嘴边垂着一滴白色口水。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Anime-style Naiwa looking upward in a blue-gray high-collared uniform
title.zh: 动漫风奶蛙穿蓝灰高领制服仰望

description.en: An illustrated Naiwa wears a blue-gray high-collared uniform with thin dark-red shoulder accents, looking upward with round green eyes against a dark, leafy background. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 绘画风奶蛙穿着蓝灰色高领制服，肩部有深红细条，圆绿眼向上望，深色背景中露出枝叶。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa tilting its head and flashing a V-sign for a selfie

description.en: In front of pale-gray wall tiles, Naiwa holds a phone up high, tilts its head with a toothy smile, and makes a V-sign beside its face. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙在浅灰瓷砖墙前把手机举高，歪着头露齿微笑，另一只手在脸旁摆出V字手势。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Bowl-cut Naiwa sticking its tongue out by a window
title.zh: 蘑菇头奶蛙在窗边吐舌

description.en: With a dark-brown bowl haircut, Naiwa faces sideways beside a window, opens its round green eye wide, and sticks its pink tongue forward. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙顶着深棕色蘑菇头，以侧脸朝向窗边，圆绿眼睁大，粉色舌头向前伸出。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa drinking from a bottle in a rainy car
title.zh: 奶蛙在雨夜车内举瓶喝饮料

description.en: Inside a dim car beside a rain-streaked window, Naiwa holds a glass bottle of amber-colored drink to its mouth and looks downcast. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙坐在昏暗车厢里，靠近布满雨痕的车窗，把装有琥珀色饮料的玻璃瓶举到嘴边，眼神低落。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa clutching its head and crying

description.en: Naiwa clutches both sides of its head, opens its mouth wide, and cries with two exaggerated blue streams of tears below its eyes. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙双手抱住头部，张大嘴巴，眼下挂着两条夸张的蓝色泪水。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa calling the Naiwa family on a telephone
title.zh: 奶蛙拿电话呼叫奶家人

description.en: Naiwa holds a black corded receiver to its ear with one hand and rests the other on its hip. The image says “Calling the Naiwa family,” with red and green call-button graphics below. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙一只手把黑色有线听筒贴在耳边，另一只手叉腰；画面写着“呼叫奶家人”，下方配有红绿电话按钮图案。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa staring blankly with a Gaze of a god caption
title.zh: 奶蛙呆望配字神的凝视

description.en: In a face close-up, Naiwa looks straight ahead with round green eyes and a slightly open mouth. A red label reads “The gaze of a god.” The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙面部近景中圆绿眼直视前方，嘴巴轻轻张开，胸前红底白字写着“神的凝视”。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa with wide round eyes and an outstretched tongue

description.en: A head close-up shows Naiwa with wide round green eyes, an open mouth, and a long pink tongue extended outward. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙头部近景中，圆绿眼睁大，嘴巴张开，一条粉红色舌头长长伸在嘴外。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa smiling with a hand on its forehead

description.en: Naiwa rests one hand on its forehead and the other arm across a tabletop, tilting its head with a toothy smile. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙一只手扶着额头，另一条手臂横放在桌面上，歪头露出带牙齿的微笑。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Haloed Naiwa crossing its arms with a Feels sacred caption
title.zh: 光环奶蛙抱臂说觉得很神圣

description.en: Naiwa stands with its arms crossed inside a glowing gold-white halo. White text below reads “But I think it's very sacred.” The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙双臂交叉站立，身后环绕金白色发光圆环，下方白字写着“可是我觉得很神圣啊”。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa glaring with a deeply furrowed brow

description.en: An extreme close-up shows Naiwa with a deeply furrowed brow, narrowed eyes, and a downturned mouth. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙的面部近景中，眉头深深皱起，眼睛眯成窄缝，嘴角向下。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Tuxedo Naiwa gaping in surprise with a stunned caption
title.zh: 礼服奶蛙惊讶张嘴配愣住了文字

description.en: Wearing a black tuxedo jacket, white shirt, and black bow tie, Naiwa opens the round green eyes on its elongated face and gapes with an oval mouth. The original caption says “Nailong was instantly stunned.” The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙穿黑色礼服外套、白衬衫和黑领结，细长脸上的圆绿眼睁大，嘴巴张成椭圆；下方原有文字写着“奶龙瞬间愣住了”。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa squinting one eye with a toothy grin
title.zh: 奶蛙眯起一只眼咧嘴笑

description.en: In this close-up, Naiwa opens one round green eye wide, squints the other, and shows a row of teeth in a broad grin. Raised arms extend behind its head, and a Douyin account watermark appears at the bottom. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙近景中一只圆绿眼睁大，另一只眯成细缝，嘴巴露出一排牙齿；身后横着抬起的手臂，底部有抖音账号水印。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Classroom Naiwa trying not to laugh with an ironic caption
title.zh: 教室奶蛙窃笑配字差点绷住

description.en: Two Naiwa sit behind green classroom desks. One holds a hand near its mouth as if whispering, while the other puffs its cheeks and presses its lips together. A red banner reads “Phew, I almost kept a straight face,” an ironic caption. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 两只奶蛙坐在教室绿色课桌后，一只把手放到嘴边像在耳语，另一只鼓腮抿嘴；下方红底白字写着“好险差点就绷住了”。保留公开展示的水印。

title.zh: 奶蛙把大拇指伸到镜头前

description.en: Naiwa stands smiling and extends a dark hand into the foreground in a prominent thumbs-up gesture. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙微笑站立，一只深色手伸到前景，比出特别显眼的大拇指点赞手势。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: A hand repeatedly patting Naiwa on the head
title.zh: 一只手反复揉奶蛙的头

description.en: A real human hand repeatedly descends over a small, arms-crossed Naiwa and pats or presses its head. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 交叉双臂的小奶蛙上方，一只真人手反复落下，揉按它的头部。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa is surrounded by golden rings in a boxing ring and grows larger before taking a fighting stance. A red caption reads “Let's see who dares mess with my little fans.” The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙在拳台上被金色光环包围、变大后摆出架势，底部红条写着“我看谁敢动我的小粉丝”。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Striped-shirt Naiwa changes from a smile to surprise
title.zh: 条纹衣奶蛙从笑脸变惊讶

description.en: Naiwa wears a black-and-white striped top against a brick wall, turning its head as its smile changes into a wide-mouthed surprised expression. A black vertical edge appears later in the clip. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 砖墙前，穿黑白条纹衣的奶蛙转动头部，从张嘴微笑变成张大嘴的惊讶表情；画面后段出现黑色竖边。 保留公开展示水印。

title.zh: 植物装饰绿奶蛙惊讶张嘴

description.en: Two green variants retaining Naiwa's round eyes and pale round bellies open their mouths in surprise beside a white fence. One has a sprout on its head, and the other has a red flower-like crown. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 白色栅栏前，两只保留奶蛙圆眼与浅色圆肚子的绿色变体先微笑后张嘴；一只头顶嫩芽，另一只戴红色花冠状装饰。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa laughs in front of layered text
title.zh: 密集文字背景前大笑的奶蛙

description.en: Naiwa laughs and sways in front of steps and a dense text overlay, moving its hands between its belly and chest. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙在台阶和密集文字叠层前笑着摆动身体，双手在肚子与胸前之间移动。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa laughs with a ruler at a classroom desk
title.zh: 课桌边拿尺子大笑的奶蛙

description.en: The view pulls back from Naiwa's smiling face as it holds a marked ruler in both hands and leans backward laughing beside a classroom desk. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 镜头从奶蛙笑脸近景拉远；奶蛙双手拿着带刻度的尺子，在课桌旁仰头大笑，身体向后倾。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa makes worried gestures under a blue sky
title.zh: 蓝天下手足无措的奶蛙

description.en: In front of a blue sky and railing, worried-looking Naiwa raises its hands, crosses its arms and brings a hand toward its mouth. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙在蓝天与栏杆前皱着眉，轮流抬起双手、交叠手臂并把一只手放到嘴边。 保留公开展示水印。

description.en: A small, softly fuzzy Naiwa waves, twists, kicks and bounces against a white background in a changing sequence of dance moves. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 带细软绒毛质感的小奶蛙在白色背景上挥手、扭身、踢腿和蹦跳，动作连续变化。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa sits at a desk with clasped hands
title.zh: 课桌前握手发呆的奶蛙

description.en: Naiwa sits with its hands clasped on a classroom desk and round eyes facing forward, making small movements while other yellow Naiwa figures sit behind it. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙将双手交握放在课桌上，圆眼朝前，身体轻微移动；后方还坐着其他黄色奶蛙。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa poses in a frilly blue dress
title.zh: 蓝色蓬蓬裙奶蛙摆姿势

description.en: Naiwa wears a pale-blue frilled dress with bows and a matching headpiece, turning its head, lifting its arms and posing in front of ornate heart-shaped decor. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙穿着带蝴蝶结和荷叶边的浅蓝色蓬蓬裙及配套头饰，在华丽的心形装饰前转头、抬手和摆姿势。 保留公开展示水印。

description.en: Naiwa dances among sunlit palm trees, moving its arms and round belly, leaning its body and turning sideways. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙在阳光下的椰树间摆动手臂和圆肚子，倾斜身体并转向侧面跳舞。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa sweeps an arm across its chest

description.en: Smiling Naiwa repeatedly sweeps one dark hand across its chest, with white puff-shaped graphics on either side of the pale background. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙微笑着反复把一只深色手掌横着扫过胸前；浅色背景两侧出现白色气团状图案。 保留公开展示水印。

title.zh: 拳台上金光变身的奶蛙

description.en: A small Naiwa stands in a boxing ring with yellow figures lying behind it. Golden rings surround its body before it becomes taller and broader and takes a fighting stance. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 小奶蛙站在拳台上，身后躺着黄色角色；金色光环环绕身体后，它变成更高壮的奶蛙并摆出架势。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Bowl-cut Naiwa flips its fringe in a hallway
title.zh: 蘑菇头奶蛙在走廊翻起刘海

description.en: In a bright hallway, Naiwa gestures with one hand while its black bowl-cut fringe flips upward and then falls back over its forehead. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙在明亮走廊里伸手做手势，黑色蘑菇头刘海一度掀起，随后又落回额头。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Golden-armored Naiwa raises a staff amid lightning
title.zh: 金甲奶蛙举长杖迎接闪电

description.en: Naiwa wears a curled golden headband, ornate golden armor, and a red scarf. It raises a long staff before lightning and brilliant golden light surround it. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙戴卷纹金箍，披金色盔甲和红色围巾，举起长杖；画面随后被闪电和金色强光包围。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa waving bent hands in a library
title.zh: 奶蛙在图书馆里抬手摆动

description.en: Among wooden desks and bookshelves, Naiwa turns from side to side while repeatedly waving its bent arms with wrists hanging downward. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙站在木质书桌与书架之间，双肘弯曲、手腕下垂，左右转身并反复摆动双手。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Robed Naiwa scatters rice on a phone and is knocked back by blue light
title.zh: 道袍奶蛙给手机撒米后被蓝光震倒

description.en: Wearing a tall black hat and yellow ceremonial robe, Naiwa holds a wooden sword and scatters white rice onto a phone on the ground. A blue flash erupts from the phone and knocks it backward. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙戴黑色高帽、穿黄色道袍并拿着木剑，向地上的手机撒白米；手机冒出蓝光后，它向后跌倒。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa laughing as it flies over a mountain lake
title.zh: 奶蛙笑着飞过山间湖面

description.en: Naiwa laughs with its arms stretched back as it flies above a lake bordered by mountains and clouds. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙张嘴大笑，双臂向后伸，悬空飞过有群山和云层的湖面。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Watermelon Naiwa laughing in front of a white fence
title.zh: 西瓜奶蛙在白栅栏前捧腹大笑

description.en: A watermelon variant retains Naiwa's round eyes and broad body, with striped green rind and a curled vine on its head. In front of a white fence it changes from surprise to belly laughter. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 保留奶蛙圆眼和胖体型的西瓜变体长着卷曲瓜藤，身披绿白瓜皮条纹；它在白栅栏前从吃惊转为双手捧腹大笑。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Laughing Naiwa figures crowd a doorway

description.en: A Naiwa initially laughs inside a doorway, then more Naiwa figures crowd in from the sides and fill the entrance and tiled floor. The source's visible Sora mark and public watermark are preserved.
description.zh: 开始一只奶蛙站在门里大笑，随后更多奶蛙从旁边挤来，聚满门口与铺砖地面。原画面的Sora标记与公开水印均保留。

title.en: Naiwa punches a stack of bricks

description.en: Naiwa stands beside a red wall, steadying a stack of gray bricks with one hand and punching it with the other as fragments fly outward. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙站在红色墙边，一只手扶住灰色砖块堆，另一只手挥拳砸去，砖块碎片向旁边飞开。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: A large Naiwa swats a smaller Naiwa over
title.zh: 大奶蛙挥手把小奶蛙拍翻

description.en: On a wooden walkway at night, a large Naiwa swings a hand toward a smaller Naiwa, which topples backward onto the ground. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 夜间木板步道上，大奶蛙抬手朝小奶蛙挥去，小奶蛙向后翻倒在地。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa dances on a blue patterned rug
title.zh: 蓝色花纹地毯上跳舞的奶蛙

description.en: Seen from above, Naiwa stands on a blue patterned rug, raising and swinging its arms while shifting its feet. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 俯视镜头下，奶蛙站在蓝色花纹地毯上，一边抬手、摆臂，一边交替挪动双脚。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: A costumed group of Naiwa figures dances

description.en: A group of Naiwa figures in floral shirts, striped clothes and other outfits dances in a dark setting, repeatedly raising their arms overhead or spreading them sideways. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 一群穿着花衬衫、条纹衣等服装的奶蛙在暗处一起跳舞，反复把手臂举到头顶或向两侧展开。 保留公开展示水印。

description.en: Naiwa crosses its steps on a path at night, first holding its hands near its belly and then raising its arms and leaning sideways, with trees and a glowing streetlight behind it. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙在夜晚的小路上交叉迈步，先把双手放在肚子前，再举起手臂、侧身摆动，身后有树木和亮着的路灯。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa smiles with both hands by its mouth

description.en: Naiwa smiles with its mouth open and round green eyes, making small repeated movements with its dark fingers held close to its mouth. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙睁着绿色圆眼、张嘴微笑，反复小幅移动凑在嘴边的深色手指。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa waves its limbs while lying in bed
title.zh: 躺床上挥动手脚的奶蛙

description.en: A soft toy-like Naiwa lies on its back against gray bedding, smiling while repeatedly raising its hands and kicking its short legs. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 带柔软玩偶质感的奶蛙仰躺在灰色枕头和床被上，微笑着反复抬起双手并踢动短腿。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa stretches with its hands behind its head

description.en: Naiwa wears a white vest beside a bed, holding both hands behind its head with its elbows spread as its body moves slightly. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙穿白色背心站在卧室床边，把双手放到脑后、肘部向两侧展开，身体轻微摇动。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa lands below a high-rise and raises a finger
title.zh: 奶蛙从高楼落地后竖起手指

description.en: Naiwa drops from above a high-rise, tumbles onto the ground, stands up, and raises a long dark finger toward the camera. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙从高楼上方落向地面，翻身起立，随后朝镜头举手并竖起一根长长的深色手指。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Pink Naiwa hitting a smaller yellow character in cartoon slapstick
title.zh: 粉色奶蛙敲打小黄角色的卡通闹剧

description.en: An angry pink Naiwa punches downward at a smaller yellow character’s head with starburst impact effects, then lifts a foot and stamps down as the smaller character ducks to one side. No graphic injury is shown. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 愤怒的粉色奶蛙向下挥拳敲打小黄角色的头部，画面出现星状撞击特效；后段奶蛙抬脚向下踩，小角色缩向画面一侧，没有血腥细节。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Muscular Naiwa taps a round Naiwa's belly and laughs
title.zh: 健美奶蛙拍胖奶蛙肚子后大笑

description.en: In a gym, a muscular Naiwa taps the belly of a round Naiwa beside it and then laughs while holding its own stomach. The round Naiwa stands wide-eyed. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 健身房里，一只肌肉发达的奶蛙拍了身旁胖奶蛙的肚子，随后捧腹大笑；胖奶蛙睁着绿眼呆站。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Pink Naiwa prods a tied-up character with a thin stick
title.zh: 粉色奶蛙拿细棍戳绑在树上的角色

description.en: A pink Naiwa waves a thin stick and repeatedly prods a yellow round-eared character tied to a tree with rope, while the lighting shifts from daylight to sunset. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 粉色奶蛙挥动细棍，反复戳向被绳子绑在树上的黄色圆耳角色；背景光线从白天变成晚霞。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa swings a smaller companion and then crosses its arms
title.zh: 奶蛙拎甩小伙伴后抱臂

description.en: Beside a railing with a stormy sea behind it, a larger Naiwa swings a screaming smaller character with one hand, releases it out of the left side of the frame, and then stands with its arms crossed. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 乌云海面与栏杆前，大奶蛙用一只手拎起尖叫的小角色来回甩动，随后把它甩出左侧画面，再双臂交叉站定。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa laughing with outstretched arms in the rain
title.zh: 奶蛙在雨中张开双臂仰天大笑

description.en: Seen from above in falling rain, Naiwa spreads both arms and tips its head back with its mouth open in laughter. The view gradually pulls away to reveal more wet ground. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 俯视镜头中，奶蛙在雨里张开双臂，仰头张嘴大笑；镜头逐渐拉远，露出更多湿漉漉的地面。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa crossing and raising its arms in a plant-filled living room
title.zh: 奶蛙在绿植客厅交叉举手跳舞

description.en: In a bright living room with plants, pendant lights, and a sofa, Naiwa alternates its arms across its chest and belly, then crosses its hands above its head in a repeated dance. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙在摆着绿植、吊灯和沙发的明亮客厅里，双臂轮流横放在胸腹前，再把双手交叉举过头顶，循环跳舞。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa moving its bent arms in a warmly lit lobby
title.zh: 奶蛙在暖光大厅弯臂摆动

description.en: In a warmly lit lobby with stairs and railings, Naiwa repeatedly bends its arms, extends them to the sides, and gently sways its body. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙站在有楼梯、栏杆和金色暖光的大厅里，反复弯曲手臂、向两侧伸手，并随之轻轻摆动身体。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa falls after cycling over a speed bump
title.zh: 奶蛙骑车冲过减速带后摔倒

description.en: Naiwa cycles over a parking-area speed bump, lifts the front wheel and falls with the bicycle near orange-and-white traffic cones. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙骑自行车经过停车场减速带，前轮抬起后连车带角色摔向地面；旁边摆着橙白交通锥。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa dancing with crossing steps in a walkway
title.zh: 奶蛙在长廊里交叉步扭身跳舞

description.en: In a walkway with a low side wall, Naiwa crosses its legs in dance steps and twists from side to side, briefly touching a hand to its temple before crossing its hands in front. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙在带矮墙的长廊里交叉双腿迈步、左右扭身，一只手时而放在太阳穴旁，最后双手在身前交叠。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa stepping and swinging its arms on a night street
title.zh: 奶蛙在夜色街头摆臂踏步

description.en: On a night street lit by golden building lights, Naiwa lifts its knees and steps along while swinging its hands between its chest and sides. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙在金色灯光照亮的夜间街道上，抬起膝盖踏步，双手在胸前和身体两侧摆动。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa punching with green boxing gloves in a metallic corridor
title.zh: 奶蛙戴绿拳套在金属走廊出拳

description.en: Wearing bright green boxing gloves in a dim metallic corridor, Naiwa raises both fists and alternately extends its gloves toward the camera and draws them back. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙戴着醒目的绿色拳击手套，在昏暗金属走廊里抬起双拳，交替向镜头伸出拳套再收回。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa walking and looking around a wood-paneled corridor
title.zh: 奶蛙沿木墙走廊散步张望

description.en: Naiwa walks toward the camera through a carpeted, wood-paneled corridor, briefly raises a hand beside its face, and looks around. It passes a bright wall display and finally brings its hands together in front. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙沿木墙与地毯组成的走廊向镜头走来，途中抬手到脸旁、左右张望，经过明亮的墙面展示屏，最后在身前交叠双手。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa rotating away into the clouds
title.zh: 奶蛙翻转着远离镜头进入云层

description.en: With its limbs spread and belly initially facing upward, Naiwa rotates among clouds and becomes progressively smaller as the view pulls farther away. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙四肢张开、肚皮朝上，在云层间翻转；随着镜头距离拉开，角色越来越小，逐渐远去。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa inspecting its hand and making a fist
title.zh: 奶蛙观察自己的手掌并握拳

description.en: Naiwa looks down at its raised fist. The view switches to looking down over its belly, feet, and hand as the fingers spread and close into a fist, then moves past its head and returns to a front view. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙低头看向抬起的拳头；画面切换成向下看肚皮、双脚和手掌的视角，手掌张开再握紧，随后镜头靠近头部并回到奶蛙正面。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa dancing and waving under warm streetlights
title.zh: 奶蛙在暖色路灯下挥手跳舞

description.en: Beside a building wall and plants at night, Naiwa alternately raises and waves its hands, crosses its arms in front of its chest, continues the motions, and turns slightly at the end. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙站在夜间建筑墙边与绿植旁，轮流举起双手、向两侧挥动，手臂在胸前交叉后继续摆动，最后稍稍转身。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa jogging with swinging arms on a night street
title.zh: 奶蛙在夜间车道摆臂小跑

description.en: On a night street with passing vehicles and parked cars, Naiwa jogs toward the camera in alternating steps while swinging its arms in front of its chest and belly. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙在有行驶车辆和路边停放汽车的夜间街道上，朝镜头交替迈步小跑，双臂随之在胸腹前摆动。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Pink Naiwa gesturing with a phone at a drink counter
title.zh: 粉色奶蛙在饮品店拿手机比划

description.en: A pink Naiwa smiles while holding a smartphone behind a counter with a drink cup, jars, and checkout equipment, then frees one hand to gesture forward and point with its index finger. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 粉色奶蛙站在摆有饮料杯、罐子和收银设备的柜台后，微笑着拿手机，随后腾出一只手向前比划、伸出食指。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa gently moving its head with drooping eyes and an open mouth
title.zh: 奶蛙半睁眼张嘴轻晃脑袋

description.en: In a cutout bust view, Naiwa keeps its eyes half-lidded and mouth open while its head and upper body shift slightly from side to side, giving a tired expression. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙上半身抠图中，双眼半睁、嘴巴张开，脑袋和上身轻微左右移动，显得困倦无力。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Puffed-cheek Naiwa cycling with leafy bundles on a mountain road
title.zh: 鼓腮奶蛙骑车载着绿叶包穿过山路

description.en: A rosy, puffed-cheek Naiwa pedals along a winding mountain road with leafy bundles hanging on both sides of the bicycle and a white earphone cord across its chest. The sequence alternates between facial close-ups and wider views. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 鼓着红脸的奶蛙骑自行车沿弯曲山路前行，车身两侧挂着成捆绿叶，白色耳机线垂在胸前；镜头切换近脸和远景。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa swings its arms in a rainy street
title.zh: 雨中街头甩臂跳舞的奶蛙

description.en: Naiwa dances through a rainy street, stepping, sweeping an arm across its face and turning with broad arm swings while people pass with umbrellas. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙在下雨的街头边迈步边跳舞，时而把手臂横过脸前，时而转身甩臂；周围有人撑伞经过。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Little Naiwa gets up, jumps and face-plants again
title.zh: 小奶蛙爬起又跳扑倒地

description.en: An egg-shaped little Naiwa lifts itself from a face-down position, briefly stands, then jumps and lands face-first on the floor again. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 蛋形小奶蛙先从脸朝下的姿势抬起身体，短暂站稳后跳起，再次脸朝下扑到地面。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Cyclists ride over a Naiwa lying on the road

description.en: Naiwa lies sprawled on a road while several live-action cyclists ride one after another over its rounded body in a composited slapstick scene. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙摊躺在道路上，几名真人骑车者依次从它鼓起的身体上骑过，形成合成恶搞场景。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: A muscular mouse lifts pink Naiwa, which cries and wriggles
title.zh: 肌肉鼠拎起粉色奶蛙使它哭着挣扎

description.en: A yellow muscular mouse flexes, then grabs the top of pink Naiwa’s head and lifts it. Naiwa’s head stretches upward as its feet dangle and kick, its mouth opens in tears, and its arms spread outward. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 黄色肌肉鼠先展示手臂，再抓住粉色奶蛙头顶把它提起；奶蛙的头顶被拉长，双脚悬空摆动，张嘴流泪并伸开双臂。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Pink Naiwa flattens a mouse with a mallet and gets bitten
title.zh: 粉色奶蛙用木槌拍扁小鼠后被咬手

description.en: Pink Naiwa raises a wooden mallet and squashes a small yellow mouse into a flat shape. The mouse then regains its rounded form and bites Naiwa’s finger in non-graphic cartoon slapstick. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 粉色奶蛙举起木槌，把手边的小黄鼠拍成扁片；小鼠随即恢复立体形状并咬住奶蛙的手指，整个过程是无血腥的卡通变形闹剧。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Pink Naiwa crying after a mouse companion touches its cheek
title.zh: 粉色奶蛙被鼠伙伴碰脸后大哭

description.en: On a sofa, a yellow mouse companion first reaches over to touch pink Naiwa’s cheek. Naiwa then opens its mouth and cries with large tears while the companion waves and laughs with closed eyes. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 沙发上，黄色鼠类伙伴先伸手碰粉色奶蛙的脸；奶蛙随后张嘴流泪大哭，伙伴转而挥手、闭眼大笑。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Pink Naiwa cries after being struck with a wooden club
title.zh: 粉色奶蛙被木棍敲后大哭

description.en: A yellow mouse-like character carries a wooden club toward pink Naiwa and strikes it. Pink Naiwa sits in the street holding its head, then cries with its mouth open as exaggerated tears stream to both sides. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 黄色鼠状角色扛着木棍走向粉色奶蛙并敲打它；粉色奶蛙坐在街道上抱头，随后张嘴大哭，泪水向两边喷出。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Pink Naiwa leans close to a small mouse
title.zh: 粉色奶蛙低头靠近小鼠

description.en: On grass, smiling pink Naiwa bends forward and repeatedly brings its face close to a small yellow, large-eared mouse-like character looking up at it. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 草地上，粉色奶蛙微笑着弯身，反复把脸靠近一只仰头看它的黄色大耳鼠状角色。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Pink Naiwa tilts a container over a fallen companion
title.zh: 粉色奶蛙拿容器逗弄倒地同伴

description.en: On a street, pink Naiwa keeps one foot on a yellow mouse-like character lying on its back, repeatedly tilting a large blue-and-white container toward the companion's face and raising its free hand. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 街道上，粉色奶蛙一只脚踩着仰躺的黄色鼠状角色，反复把蓝白大容器倾向对方脸旁，并抬起另一只手。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Pink Naiwa is startled by a swinging backpack
title.zh: 粉色奶蛙被飞来的背包吓到

description.en: Inside a subway carriage, a yellow mouse-like character lifts and swings a brown backpack toward pink Naiwa, which reacts from a blue seat with wide green eyes and an open mouth. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 地铁车厢里，一只黄色鼠状角色举起并甩动棕色背包，坐在蓝色座椅上的粉色奶蛙睁大绿色眼睛、张嘴躲闪。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa alternately punching in a stairwell
title.zh: 奶蛙在楼梯间交替挥拳

description.en: Beside gray stairs and white railings, Naiwa keeps its eyes drooping while alternately punching diagonally upward and forward, gently twisting its body with the movements. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙站在灰色楼梯和白色栏杆旁，半垂着眼睛，双拳轮流向斜上方和前方挥出，身体随动作轻轻扭转。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa pointing and laughing in a subtle loop
title.zh: 奶蛙轻微循环指人大笑

description.en: Naiwa leans forward, points diagonally with one hand and rests the other near its thigh while laughing. The head, torso and arm make small repeating movements; this is not a still-image pan or zoom. The complete public GIF and watermark are preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙身体前倾，一只手斜指前方，另一只手放在大腿附近并大笑。头部、躯干和手臂有幅度较小的循环动作，不是静图平移或缩放。保留完整公开GIF及水印。

title.en: Naiwa puffs its rosy cheeks at a desk

description.en: Naiwa sits at a green classroom desk with its hands beside a book, puffing its rosy cheeks and narrowing its eyes as its pursed expression shifts slightly. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙坐在绿色课桌前，双手放在书本旁，双颊鼓起泛红，眯眼抿嘴并轻微变换表情。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa sweeping a fluffy long-handled brush toward the camera
title.zh: 奶蛙拿长柄绒刷擦向镜头

description.en: Seen from a low angle beneath a blue glass canopy, Naiwa holds a long-handled white fluffy brush and repeatedly sweeps it toward the camera, bringing the brush head across the foreground. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 低角度画面中，奶蛙站在蓝色玻璃顶棚下，手握长柄白色绒刷，来回向镜头方向擦拭，刷头多次遮住前景。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa blushes and smiles while turning its head

description.en: Naiwa faces the viewer with open round green eyes and rosy cheeks, smiling while gently turning its head from side to side. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙正面对着镜头，绿色圆眼睁开、脸颊泛红，一边微笑一边轻轻左右转头。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Little Naiwa sweeps a fluffy brush across the camera
title.zh: 小奶蛙拿绒毛刷擦向镜头

description.en: Seen from below, little Naiwa holds a long-handled fluffy brush and repeatedly sweeps its pale head across the camera, briefly obscuring the blue background with bristles. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 低视角下，小奶蛙握着长柄绒毛刷，反复把浅色刷头扫到镜头前，蓝色背景时而被刷毛遮住。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa waves paw gloves in a cat-themed frilly dress

description.en: Naiwa wears a cream layered frilly dress, a cat-ear lace headpiece and white paw gloves, with pink bows and a cat-face pouch at its waist. It waves its hands amid small decorative effects. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙穿米白色多层荷叶边裙、戴猫耳花边头饰和白色猫爪手套，胸前有粉色蝴蝶结、腰间挂猫脸小包；它挥动双手，周围冒出小装饰特效。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa dances with bottle-shaped props on grass
title.zh: 草地上拿瓶状道具跳舞的奶蛙

description.en: Naiwa dances on grass beside a low white fence, picks up and shakes two orange-red bottle-shaped props, then puts them down and turns. A small reference-picture overlay appears briefly later in the clip. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙在白色小围栏旁的草地上跳舞，拿起两只橙红色瓶状道具摇动，随后放下并转身；后段短暂出现小参考图叠层。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Captioned Naiwa reaches toward the camera

description.en: Naiwa alternates large open palms toward the camera indoors, with a red caption reading “Shou lai, shou lai,” a repeated chant meaning “May good fortune and longevity arrive,” plus a small decorative symbol. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙在室内向镜头交替伸出大手掌，脸前叠着红色配字“寿来～寿来”与小装饰符号。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa sits beside a floral-covered table
title.zh: 花布餐桌旁坐着的奶蛙

description.en: Naiwa sits in a padded chair beside a table covered with floral cloth, turning its head and making small arm and body movements with cabinets behind it. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙坐在软垫座椅上，面前是铺花布的餐桌；它转动头部、轻微移动手臂和身体，后方可见橱柜。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa waves large palms toward the camera

description.en: In an indoor close-up, Naiwa repeatedly reaches open palms toward the camera, alternating hands across its face in exaggerated near-camera perspective. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 室内近景中，奶蛙反复把张开的手掌伸向镜头，两只手交替从脸前划过，形成夸张近大远小透视。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Downcast armored Naiwa holds a sword

description.en: Naiwa wears silver armor and a pale cape, holding a long sword vertically in both hands with its head bowed and eyes downcast while its cape moves in the wind. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙穿银色铠甲与浅色披风，双手握住竖直长剑，低着头露出下垂眼神；身后披风随风飘动。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Nai Dan wiggles side to side

description.en: An egg-shaped Nai Dan smiles and wiggles from side to side, swinging its short arms and shifting on the dark floor. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛋微笑着左右扭身，短手向两侧摆动，身体在暗色地面上轻轻移动。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Little Nai Dan tilts its head and touches it

description.en: Little Nai Dan lifts a short hand to the side of its head, leaning its body to one side before swaying back. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛋把一只短手抬到头侧，身体跟着向一边倾斜，再缓缓摆回来。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Little Nai Dan scowls and sulks

description.en: An egg-shaped Nai Dan lowers its brows and turns down its mouth, holding its short arms out at its sides while swaying slightly. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛋皱起眉头、嘴巴下弯，短手撑向身体两侧，身体轻微摇晃。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Nai Dan laughs with its hands on its belly

description.en: Little Nai Dan changes from a standing smile to open-mouthed laughter, lowering its body with its short hands near its belly before standing again. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛋从站立微笑转为张嘴大笑，身体向下缩，短手放到肚子前，随后又恢复站姿。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Little Nai Dan gently sways while standing

description.en: An egg-shaped Nai Dan stands facing forward with round green eyes, making small movements of its body and short arms. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛋正面站立，绿色圆眼看着前方，身体和短手轻微晃动。 保留公开展示水印。

description.en: An egg-shaped Nai Dan leans from side to side and turns on a dark floor, its short arms extending with the wobbling motion. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 蛋形的奶蛋在暗色地面上左右倾斜、转身摇摆，短小手臂随身体动作伸向两边。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa laughing with rosy cheeks and its tongue out

description.en: Naiwa squints and laughs with rounded rosy cheeks, an open mouth, and a pink tongue sticking out. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙鼓着泛红的脸颊，眯眼张嘴大笑，粉色舌头伸在嘴外。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Close-up of Naiwa making a shushing gesture

description.en: Naiwa smiles with round green eyes and holds a dark finger upright in front of its mouth in a shushing gesture. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙睁着绿色圆眼微笑，把一根深色手指竖在嘴唇前做“嘘”的动作。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa laughs wrapped in cabbage leaves

description.en: Naiwa laughs with both hands on its belly while layers of green-and-white cabbage leaves wrap around its body. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙双手捂着肚子笑，身体外包着层层绿色与白色的大白菜叶。 保留公开展示水印。

description.en: Naiwa tilts its head slightly and holds an orange fruit in both hands in front of its chest against a white background. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙轻轻歪头，用双手把一颗橙色的橘子捧在胸前，背景为白色。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Bow-wearing Naiwa holds a green check-mark sign
title.zh: 蝴蝶结奶蛙举绿色对勾牌

description.en: A chibi Naiwa with a yellow bow tilts its head and smiles while holding a green circular sign with a white check mark. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 头戴黄色蝴蝶结的Q版奶蛙歪头微笑，举着绿色圆牌，牌上是白色对勾。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa in a blue-and-white striped swimsuit
title.zh: 穿蓝白条纹泳装的奶蛙

description.en: Naiwa stands against white wearing a tied two-piece swimsuit with blue-and-white horizontal stripes. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙站在白色背景前，穿着带系带的蓝白横条纹两件式泳装。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa sees its black forelock in a round mirror
title.zh: 奶蛙对着圆镜看黑色翘刘海

description.en: Inside a round mirror frame, Naiwa has a raised black forelock, wide green eyes and a slightly open mouth. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 圆形镜框里，奶蛙顶着向前翘起的黑色刘海，睁大绿色眼睛并微张嘴巴。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Praying Naiwa: God, will you save me?
title.zh: 奶蛙祈祷：神你会拯救我吗

description.en: Naiwa closes its eyes and presses its palms together beside vertical text reading “God, will you save me?” The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙闭眼合掌，旁边竖排文字写着“神你会拯救我吗”。 保留公开展示水印。

description.en: Naiwa tilts its head and sticks out its tongue above a red caption asking, “Are you mad, handsome?” The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙歪着头吐舌头，身前红色横条配字为“气不气小哥哥”。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Sunglasses Naiwa driving a blue cargo tricycle
title.zh: 墨镜奶蛙开蓝色货运三轮车

description.en: A sunglasses-wearing Naiwa drives a blue cargo tricycle, gripping its handlebars, with a second Naiwa partly visible in the rear cargo bed. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 戴墨镜的奶蛙坐在蓝色货运三轮车前方握住车把，后斗露出另一只奶蛙的一部分。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Seated Naiwa: Easily keeping a straight face

description.en: Naiwa sits on a stone ledge with its hands on its thighs. White text on a red banner reads “Easily keeping a straight face.” The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙坐在石台上，双手放在腿上，下方红底白字写着“轻松绷住”。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa makes a heart with both hands

description.en: Naiwa smiles toward the viewer with both hands at chest level, shaping its fingers into a small heart. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙面对镜头微笑，把双手放在胸前，手指围成小小的爱心形状。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Blushing Naiwa holds a Naiwa-family flag

description.en: Naiwa puffs its rosy cheeks and narrows its eyes with a pursed mouth while holding a yellow flag reading “Naiwa family.” The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙鼓着红脸、眯眼抿嘴，举着黄色小旗，旗上写着“奶家人”。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: A small mouse licks Naiwa's toes

description.en: Naiwa sits with its legs extended while a small yellow mouse-like character with large rounded ears leans toward its foot and touches the toes with its tongue. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙坐在地上双腿向前伸，一只长着大圆耳的小黄色鼠状角色凑近它的脚，伸舌碰到脚趾。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Bow-wearing Naiwa on a pedestal among clouds
title.zh: 云间台座上的蝴蝶结奶蛙

description.en: A small round Naiwa with a yellow bow stands on a pale-blue pedestal surrounded by clouds, its round green eyes open. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 小小的圆身奶蛙头顶黄色蝴蝶结，站在云雾包围的浅蓝色台座上，睁着绿色圆眼。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Chibi Naiwa rests a hand on its chin

description.en: A standing chibi Naiwa holds one hand beside its chin, looking slightly to the side with round green eyes and a small smile. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: Q版奶蛙站立着，一只手抵在下巴旁，绿色圆眼看向侧前方，嘴角轻轻上扬。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Round Naiwa sitting on a night-time railing with a cigarette
title.zh: 圆奶蛙坐在夜间栏杆上叼烟

description.en: A round Naiwa sits on a railing in a dim night scene, holding a white cigarette at its mouth while looking forward with round green eyes. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 圆滚滚的奶蛙坐在昏暗夜景中的栏杆上，嘴边叼着一根白色香烟，圆绿眼看向前方。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa looking upward with puckered lips

description.en: In a frontal close-up, Naiwa looks upward with half-lidded green eyes and puckered small pink lips. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙从正面近距离看向上方，半垂的绿眼下方嘟起粉红色小嘴唇。保留公开展示的水印。

title.zh: 奶蛙半垂眼嘟起厚嘴唇

description.en: With its round green eyes half-lidded, Naiwa puckers a pair of pronounced pink lips against a pale indoor wall. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙半垂着圆绿眼，嘴部变成向前嘟起的粉色厚嘴唇，背景为浅色墙面。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa scowls with its hands on its hips

description.en: Naiwa plants its hands on its hips, with sharply lowered brows over green eyes and its mouth pressed into a short line. The pose remains effectively still across two frames. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙双手叉腰，绿色眼睛上方压成斜角，嘴巴紧抿成一条短线。双帧中的姿势基本不变。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa winks and sticks out its tongue

description.en: A chibi Naiwa stands with one eye scrunched shut and its tongue sticking out. The expression remains effectively still across two frames. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: Q版奶蛙站立着，一只眼睛闭成折线，嘴巴张开露出舌头。双帧中的表情基本不变。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa stands with a gentle smile

description.en: A chibi Naiwa stands facing forward with short arms by its sides, wide round eyes and a small smile. The pose remains effectively still across two frames. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: Q版奶蛙正面站立，短手垂在身体两侧，圆眼睁大、嘴角微微上扬。双帧中的姿势基本不变。 保留公开展示水印。

description.en: A chibi Naiwa presents its rounded back and leans forward, looking over its shoulder with round green eyes and a smile. The pose remains effectively still across two frames. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: Q版奶蛙侧背对着镜头，圆滚滚的身体向前倾，回头露出绿色圆眼和微笑。双帧中的姿势基本不变。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Arms-folded Naiwa: You're already crying in frustration

description.en: Naiwa stands with folded arms above red text reading “You've already cried in frustration.” The character remains effectively still across the two frames. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙抱着双臂站立，下方红字为“你已急哭”。双帧中的角色姿势基本不变。 保留公开展示水印。

description.en: Naiwa is shaped like a capital G, with a golden-yellow upper section, a pale lower section, round green eyes and a smile at the top. The design remains effectively still across two frames. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙被做成大写字母G形，上半部是金黄色，下部是浅色，顶部有绿色圆眼和微笑。双帧中的造型基本不变。 保留公开展示水印。

description.en: Yellow Naiwa forms a hollow O shape, with round eyes and a small mouth at the top and folded arms across the middle. The design remains effectively still across two frames. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 黄色奶蛙呈中空的O形，顶部是圆眼和小嘴，双臂交叠在中间。双帧中的造型基本不变。 保留公开展示水印。

description.en: Yellow Naiwa is shaped like a capital E, with round eyes and a small mouth on the top bar and folded arms across its middle. The design remains effectively still across two frames. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 黄色奶蛙被做成大写字母E的形状，顶端有圆眼和小嘴，手臂交叠在中间。双帧中的造型基本不变。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa scratches its head in confusion

description.en: A chibi Naiwa holds one hand against the side of its head, tilting slightly with a downturned mouth. The pose remains effectively still across the two frames. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: Q版奶蛙把一只手放到头侧，微微歪头、嘴巴下弯。双帧文件中的姿势基本不变。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa on the ground: Bro, I fell over
title.zh: 趴地奶蛙：哥哥我摔倒了

description.en: A chibi Naiwa lies low on the ground with its front paws supporting its body above the caption “Bro, I fell over.” The character remains effectively still across the two frames. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: Q版奶蛙趴在地上，前爪撑着身体，下方配字为“哥哥我摔倒了”。双帧文件中的角色姿势基本不变。 保留公开展示水印。

description.en: Naiwa crosses its arms over its torso and glares forward with a furrowed brow and angry green eyes. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙双臂交叉在胸腹前，眉头紧皱，圆绿眼愤怒地瞪着前方。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa leaning back against a railing by the night sea
title.zh: 奶蛙在夜海栏杆边后仰发呆

description.en: Naiwa rests both arms on a seaside railing, leans its body backward with its belly forward, and looks up into a deep-blue night sky. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙把双臂搭在海边栏杆上，腹部前挺、身体后仰，抬眼望着深蓝色夜空。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa holding its belly with a That cracked me up caption
title.zh: 奶蛙捧腹笑配字笑死我了

description.en: Naiwa laughs with closed eyes and an open mouth while holding its belly. White, black-outlined text across its chest reads “That cracked me up.” The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙闭眼张嘴大笑，双手捧在肚子上，胸前白字黑边写着“笑死我了”。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Naiwa covering its mouth with its legs crossed
title.zh: 奶蛙捂嘴交叉腿惊讶站立

description.en: Naiwa opens its round green eyes and mouth wide, raises both hands over its mouth, and crosses its legs with one foot lifted in a surprised pose. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙睁圆绿眼、张大嘴，双手举到嘴前，双腿交叉且一只脚抬起，呈惊讶姿态。保留公开展示的水印。

title.en: Round Naiwa drinking bubble tea through a straw
title.zh: 圆奶蛙用吸管喝珍珠奶茶

description.en: A small round Naiwa stands facing forward, holding a milk-tea cup with black tapioca pearls and sipping through a bent white straw. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 小圆奶蛙正面站立，一只手拿着装有黑色珍珠的奶茶杯，白色弯吸管伸到小嘴里。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa stands on all fours and looks back with its tongue out, with a red label on its rear reading “Do not eat.” Its pose remains effectively still across the six-frame file. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙四肢着地，回头吐舌头，后臀位置贴着红底白字“防吃。”。六帧文件中姿势基本不变。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Naiwa in a black balaclava and cape labeled Nai-thief
title.zh: 奶蛙戴黑头套披风标着奶偷

description.en: Naiwa wears a black knitted balaclava and cape that leave its round green eyes and small mouth visible. It crosses its arms above red belly text reading “Nai-thief,” a wordplay on Naiwa and thief. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙戴黑色针织头套和披风，露出圆绿眼和小嘴，双臂交叉抱在胸前，肚皮上红字写着“奶偷”。保留公开展示的水印。

description.en: Naiwa grips a vertical edge on the right with both hands and peeks its head and part of its body around it, looking forward through round green eyes. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 奶蛙把双手抓在画面右侧的竖直边缘上，从边缘后探出头和半边身体，绿色圆眼望向前方。 保留公开展示水印。

description.en: A smooth yellow egg-shaped Nai Dan stands against a pale background, showing round green eyes and a thin smile without visible limbs. The public watermark is preserved.
description.zh: 光滑的黄色奶蛋立在浅色背景前，只有绿色圆眼与细细的微笑，没有可见四肢。 保留公开展示水印。

title.en: Bruised Nai Shu cries with clasped paws (probable family match)
title.zh: 受伤奶鼠合掌哭泣（家族名图推定匹配）

description.en: A yellow round-eared mouse with purple bruises lies low, raises its head with tears and clasps its forepaws at its chest. A live-action fist swings toward it, after which it bends and hunches over. The source labels Nai Shu; independent comparison with the named reference supports a probable family match, not official-canon proof. The public watermark is preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 身上带紫色伤痕的黄色圆耳鼠先趴在地上，再抬头流泪、把前爪合在胸前；画面中的真人拳头挥向它，它随后弯腰缩身。来源标注奶鼠，经独立对照具名参考图后视为较可信的家族外观匹配，并非官方设定证明。公开水印原样保留。

title.en: Nai Shu's stick gag makes a W-shaped Naiwa cry

description.en: Nai Shu holds and moves a short brown stick beside a W-shaped Naiwa. The letter-shaped companion changes from a displeased folded-arm pose to open-mouthed crying, while Nai Shu begins laughing. The complete public file and watermark are preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 奶鼠拿着棕色短棍站在W字母形奶蛙旁，抬手摆动棍子；W形同伴从抱臂不悦变成张嘴流泪，奶鼠随后张嘴笑起来。 完整公开文件与水印原样保留。

title.en: Nai Shu waves and smiles with its mouth open

description.en: Nai Shu stands on pale floor tiles, first raising one hand in greeting, then lifting both hands and smiling with narrowed eyes and an open mouth; its thin tail curves behind it. The complete public file and watermark are preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 奶鼠站在浅色地砖上，先抬起一只手打招呼，再举起双手、眯眼张嘴微笑，细长尾巴在身后弯着。 完整公开文件与水印原样保留。

title.en: Nai Shu flattens and springs back beneath a large pink companion
title.zh: 床上的奶鼠被大粉色同伴压扁又弹起

description.en: A small Nai Shu stands on bedding while a much larger pink companion repeatedly jumps and lands on or over the smaller figure. Nai Shu briefly flattens like a thin disc, then regains its shape and raises its hands with a startled open mouth. The complete public file and watermark are preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 小奶鼠站在床铺上，巨大的粉色同伴反复跳起并落到它身上或上方；奶鼠被压成薄片状后又恢复立体，惊讶地张嘴抬手。 完整公开文件与水印原样保留。

title.en: Nai Shu greets the viewer on a park lawn
title.zh: 公园草地上打招呼的奶鼠

description.en: Nai Shu waves and gently moves its arms on a sunlit park lawn, repeatedly narrowing its eyes as it smiles. A much smaller pink companion sits beside it. The complete public file and watermark are preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 奶鼠在阳光照射的公园草地上挥手、轻轻摆动双臂，微笑时反复眯起眼睛；旁边坐着一只很小的粉色同伴。 完整公开文件与水印原样保留。

title.en: Nai Shu shows a drawing and receives a head pat
title.zh: 奶鼠展示画像后被摸头

description.en: Nai Shu holds up a sheet with a drawing of a large-eared mouse and turns it toward the viewer. After lowering the paper, it receives a gentle head pat from a real hand and smiles with its eyes closed and mouth open. The complete public file and watermark are preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 奶鼠双手拿着画有大耳小鼠的纸张，转向镜头展示；放下画纸后，一只真人手轻轻摸它的头，它闭眼张嘴笑起来。 完整公开文件与水印原样保留。

title.en: Nai Shu sways and greets on a night street
title.zh: 夜街上摇摆打招呼的奶鼠

description.en: Nai Shu stands on a street lined with parked cars at night, lifting a foot and swaying while alternately raising its hands near its chest with an open-mouthed smile. The complete public file and watermark are preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 奶鼠站在停着汽车的夜间街道上，抬起一只脚、摆动身体，双手在胸前交替抬起，张嘴微笑。 完整公开文件与水印原样保留。

title.en: Nai Shu is pressed by a large boot in muddy water
title.zh: 泥水里的奶鼠遭大皮鞋挤压

description.en: A mud-stained Nai Shu crouches on wet ground while a large black boot repeatedly presses it from above, making it tip and hunch over. Mud and debris cling beneath the boot. The complete public file and watermark are preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 沾着污泥的奶鼠蜷在湿地上，一只黑色大皮鞋从上方反复挤压它，使它歪倒和缩身；鞋底带着泥水与碎屑。 完整公开文件与水印原样保留。

title.en: A Nai Shu punching bag hangs from a chain

description.en: A yellow Nai Shu-shaped punching bag hangs from a chain in a dim indoor space, with round ears and a thin tail visible. It sways gently while its mouth shape changes slightly. The complete public file and watermark are preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 奶鼠造型的黄色沙袋悬挂在铁链上，圆耳和细尾清楚可见；沙袋轻轻摆动，脸上的嘴型也略有变化，背景是昏暗的室内场地。 完整公开文件与水印原样保留。

title.en: An electrical probe zaps Nai Shu's belly
title.zh: 电光探头对准奶鼠肚子

description.en: A metal probe releases blue-white electrical arcs against the belly of a reclining Nai Shu. It cries out, shifts its body, becomes blackened and emits smoke. The complete public file and watermark are preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 一个金属探头对准躺着的奶鼠肚子放出蓝白电光，奶鼠惊叫，随后翻动身体，身上变黑并冒出烟雾。 完整公开文件与水印原样保留。

title.en: Nai Shu is zapped and turns soot-black

description.en: After a pink finger presses a wall switch, blue-white sparks flash around Nai Shu, which is wrapped in loops of wire. It opens its mouth in a scream, turns soot-black, emits smoke and develops crossed-out eyes. The complete public file and watermark are preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 粉色手指按下墙面开关后，缠着多圈金属线的奶鼠周围闪起蓝白电光；它张嘴尖叫，随后变得焦黑、冒烟，双眼变成叉号。 完整公开文件与水印原样保留。

title.zh: 奶蛙手机守护闪电壁纸

description.en: An outlined Naiwa with folded arms fills a pastel blue-pink wallpaper with lightning, chains, and circular symbols. Large Chinese text means “Do not touch my phone.” The unchanged published JPEG is preserved.
description.zh: 描边奶蛙双臂交叉，占据蓝粉渐变壁纸，背景有闪电、链条和圆形符号；大字写着“别碰本尊手机”。保留已发表的未修改JPEG。

title.en: Nai Tun with a flippered tail holding its belly
title.zh: 奶豚抱腹展现鳍状尾部

description.en: A yellow aquatic-shaped family character is shown in profile, holding its pale belly with small arms. Its body tapers into a flippered tail, and a green-ringed eye is visible. The unchanged publicly displayed PNG is preserved; this is a published character depiction, not a claim of a real animal.
description.zh: 黄色水生形态家族角色侧身用小手抱着浅色肚子，身体向下收窄并接鳍状尾部，一只绿环眼可见。保留公开展示的未修改PNG；这是已发表的角色图像，不声称是真实动物。

title.en: Nai Xiang standing with its trunk lowered

description.en: A yellow elephant-shaped family character stands on four legs with broad ears and a lowered curved trunk. Its eye retains a green ring. The unchanged publicly displayed PNG is preserved; this is a published character depiction, not a claim of a real animal.
description.zh: 黄色象形家族角色四足站立，长着宽耳朵，弯曲的长鼻垂下，眼睛保留绿色圆环。保留公开展示的未修改PNG；这是已发表的角色图像，不声称是真实动物。

description.en: A yellow horse-shaped family character with a rounded torso, four hooved legs, a long tail and green-ringed eyes lifts one foreleg. The unchanged publicly displayed PNG is preserved; this is a published character depiction, not a claim of a real animal.
description.zh: 黄色马形家族角色长圆躯干、四条带蹄腿、长尾和绿环眼，抬起一条前腿。保留公开展示的未修改PNG；这是已发表的角色图像，不声称是真实动物。

title.en: Nai Hou touching the top of its head

description.en: A yellow monkey-shaped family character with small round ears, green-ringed eyes and a curled tail stands with one hand resting on the top of its head. The unchanged publicly displayed PNG is preserved; this is a published character depiction, not a claim of a real animal.
description.zh: 黄色猴形家族角色长小圆耳、绿环眼和卷尾，站着把一只手放在头顶。保留公开展示的未修改PNG；这是已发表的角色图像，不声称是真实动物。

description.en: A round yellow mouse-shaped family character with large round ears, green-ringed eyes and a thin curved tail raises one hand beside its body. The unchanged publicly displayed PNG is preserved; this is a published character depiction, not a claim of a real animal.
description.zh: 圆胖的黄色鼠形家族角色长大圆耳、绿环眼和细弯尾，在身体旁举起一只手。保留公开展示的未修改PNG；这是已发表的角色图像，不声称是真实动物。

title.en: Nai Zhu reclining with its head propped up

description.en: A yellow pig-shaped family character reclines on its side, supporting its head with one hand. It has a round snout, pointed ears and visible green-ringed eyes. The unchanged publicly displayed PNG is preserved; this is a published character depiction, not a claim of a real animal.
description.zh: 黄色猪形家族角色侧躺，一只手撑着头，圆鼻吻、尖耳和绿环眼可见。保留公开展示的未修改PNG；这是已发表的角色图像，不声称是真实动物。

title.en: Nai Tu standing with long upright ears

description.en: A yellow rabbit-shaped family character stands upright with two long ears, a rounded belly, small paws and green-ringed eyes. The unchanged publicly displayed PNG is preserved; this is a published character depiction, not a claim of a real animal.
description.zh: 黄色兔形家族角色直立站着，竖起两只长耳朵，圆肚子、小爪子和绿环眼清晰可见。保留公开展示的未修改PNG；这是已发表的角色图像，不声称是真实动物。

title.en: Nai Shu looks startled while holding cheese

description.en: Nai Shu holds a pale hole-filled piece of cheese in both hands, widening its green eyes and opening its mouth in surprise against a dim background. The complete public file and watermark are preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 奶鼠双手捧着一块带孔的浅色奶酪，绿色圆眼睁大、嘴巴张开，昏暗背景中显得有些惊讶。 完整公开文件与水印原样保留。

title.en: Nai Shu holds a Mouse Family Army flag

description.en: Nai Shu raises an orange-yellow flag reading “Mouse Family Army.” Its oversized round ears, green eyes, thin tail, and small smile are clearly visible. The complete public file and watermark are preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 奶鼠抬着一只手，举起橙黄色小旗，旗上竖写“鼠家军”；巨大圆耳、绿色圆眼、细尾与微笑清晰可见。 完整公开文件与水印原样保留。

title.en: Nai Shu folds its arms in overalls with a displeased look
title.zh: 背带裤奶鼠抱臂不高兴

description.en: Nai Shu wears blue-gray overalls and folds its arms across its chest, with half-lidded green eyes, lowered brows and a downturned mouth. The complete public file and watermark are preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 奶鼠穿蓝灰色背带裤，胸前交叉双臂，绿色眼睛半垂着，眉头紧皱，嘴角向下。 完整公开文件与水印原样保留。

title.en: Nai Shu's mugshot: Guilty of being cute

description.en: A two-dimensional Nai Shu stands before height-marker lines and holds a placard reading “Guilty of being cute.” Its green eyes are open and its thin tail extends to the right. The complete public file and watermark are preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 二维风格奶鼠站在身高刻度线前，双手举着写有“可爱罪”的牌子，绿色圆眼睁开，细尾向右伸出。 完整公开文件与水印原样保留。

title.en: Pink Naiwa holds a closed-eyed Nai Shu
title.zh: 粉色奶蛙抱着闭眼奶鼠

description.en: Pink Naiwa holds Nai Shu in its arms and lowers its mouth close to the mouse's ear. Nai Shu keeps its eyes closed while resting against the larger figure. The complete public file and watermark are preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 粉色奶蛙双臂抱着奶鼠，低下头把嘴靠在奶鼠耳朵附近；奶鼠闭着眼睛，身体靠在它怀里。 完整公开文件与水印原样保留。

title.en: Nai Shu gives a narrowed-eye grin
title.zh: 奶鼠眯眼露出狡黠笑容

description.en: Nai Shu grins with its upper teeth visible and mouth corners raised, narrowing its eyes in front of a park background with oversized round ears on either side of its head. The complete public file and watermark are preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 奶鼠在公园背景前露出上排牙齿，嘴角向两边扬起，双眼半眯着，巨大圆耳分列头部两侧。 完整公开文件与水印原样保留。

title.en: A tiny waving Nai Shu figurine held between fingers
title.zh: 手指间挥手的奶鼠小玩偶

description.en: A hand holds a tiny yellow Nai Shu figurine between its fingers. The figure raises one hand and shows oversized round ears, green eyes and a small smile in front of a laptop keyboard. The complete public file and watermark are preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 一只手把黄色奶鼠小玩偶捏在指间，玩偶抬起一只手，露出巨大圆耳、绿色圆眼和细小微笑，后面是笔记本电脑键盘。 完整公开文件与水印原样保留。

title.en: A vanful of Nai Dan with a teasing caption

description.en: Several yellow, egg-shaped Nai Dan crowd inside and around an open van. The caption reads “I'll bring a vanload of Nai Dan to deal with you.” This is a nearly static two-frame public GIF, counted as one depiction only. The downloaded public bytes and watermark are unchanged.
description.zh: 多只黄色蛋形奶蛋挤在敞门面包车内外，字幕写“找一车奶蛋弄你”。原文件是近乎静止的两帧公开GIF，只算一个图像作品。下载的公开原字节和水印均未改动。

description.en: Nai Dan wears a brown beret and holds a brush and palette beside a landscape easel in a grassy field.
description.zh: 奶蛋戴棕色贝雷帽，在草地上拿画笔和调色板，面对风景画架。

title.en: Nai Dan swimming in clear water

description.en: Nai Dan floats in bright turquoise water with its small arms spread to the sides.
description.zh: 奶蛋漂在明亮的蓝绿色水中，两只小手伸向两侧。

description.en: Nai Dan sits at a café table holding a latte while making a peace sign with its other hand.
description.zh: 奶蛋坐在咖啡馆木桌边，拿着拉花咖啡，另一只手比耶。

description.en: Nai Dan smiles beside a white lamb on the grass.
description.zh: 奶蛋在草地上靠着一只白色小羊微笑。

description.en: Nai Dan wears a yellow nightcap with white trim behind a small cake with a candle and a Nai Dan-shaped decoration.
description.zh: 奶蛋戴黄色白边睡帽，站在有蜡烛和奶蛋造型装饰的小蛋糕后。

description.en: Nai Shu wears a pumpkin-shaped suit and leafy hood and carries a small pumpkin bucket.
description.zh: 奶鼠穿南瓜形连体衣和带叶子的兜帽，提着小南瓜篮。

description.en: Nai Shu wears a red-blue diamond-pattern clown suit and pointed cap, with a red nose and a red balloon.
description.zh: 奶鼠穿红蓝菱形图案小丑服和尖帽，画红鼻子，拿着红气球。

description.en: Nai Shu wears a black suit, red bow tie and red-black cape, showing two small fangs and raising a hand.
description.zh: 奶鼠穿黑色礼服、红领结和红黑披风，露出两颗小尖牙并举手。

description.en: Nai Shu wears a red horned cape, holds a trident and has a red pointed tail behind it.
description.zh: 奶鼠穿红色带角斗篷，拿着三叉戟，身后有红色尖尾巴。

title.en: Nai Shu black robe and scythe

description.en: Nai Shu wears a black hooded robe with a skull ornament, holds a scythe and has small bat wings.
description.zh: 奶鼠穿黑色兜帽长袍，腰间有骷髅装饰，手拿镰刀，背有小蝙蝠翅膀。

description.en: Nai Shu wears a black bat-hood costume and purple bow, with purple bat wings spread behind it.
description.zh: 奶鼠穿黑色蝙蝠兜帽服和紫色蝴蝶结，背后展开紫色蝙蝠翅膀。

description.en: Nai Shu wears a black-and-white nun costume and a cross necklace, raising one hand.
description.zh: 奶鼠穿黑白修女服，戴十字架项链，举起一只手。

description.en: Nai Shu wears a black jumpsuit printed with a white skeleton and raises one hand.
description.zh: 奶鼠穿印有白色骨架的黑色连体服并举手。

description.en: Nai Shu wears a white ghost-sheet costume, carries a small ghost bag and raises one hand.
description.zh: 奶鼠披白色幽灵床单装，手提小幽灵袋并举手。

title.en: Nai Shu witch hat and broom

description.en: Nai Shu wears a purple pointed hat and a spiderweb-pattern cloak while holding a broom.
description.zh: 奶鼠戴紫色尖帽，披有蜘蛛网图案的斗篷，手拿扫帚。

title.en: Nai Dou soaking in a hot spring

description.en: Round Nai Dou soaks in a steaming hot spring with its head above the water.
description.zh: 圆润的奶豆泡在冒着蒸汽的温泉中，头部露出水面。

title.en: Little Nai Dous sharing a hot spring

description.en: Several round little Nai Dous share a hot spring, some with white towels on their heads; the character label follows the source description.
description.zh: 多只圆润的小奶豆泡在温泉中，其中一些头顶搭着白毛巾；称谓依据原帖描述。

description.en: Little Naiwa stands smiling on a white background with both arms open to the sides.
description.zh: 小奶蛙在白色背景上站立微笑，双臂向两侧张开。

title.en: Nai Dan on a white background

description.en: Egg-shaped Nai Dan faces the viewer with green eyes and a small open-mouth smile.
description.zh: 蛋形的奶蛋正面朝向画面，绿色眼睛，微微张嘴微笑。
