description.en: Nai Gou stands on four legs with brown floppy ears and paws, its tail raised as it laughs with closed eyes and an open mouth.
description.zh: 奶狗四脚站立，棕色垂耳和爪子，抬起尾巴，闭眼张嘴大笑。

description.en: Nai Dou is a round yellow character with green eyes and tiny feet below its body.
description.zh: 奶豆是圆球状黄色角色，绿色眼睛，下方有短小的脚。

title.en: Dou Nai with a bob haircut and yellow body

description.en: The character labeled Dou Nai by the source has a human-style face with a black bob haircut, a yellow body, a pale belly and dark hands and feet.
description.zh: 原帖称为豆奶的角色有短黑发人形面孔、黄色身体、浅色肚皮和深色手脚。

title.en: Hand-drawn Naiwa shyly covers its face and peeks
title.zh: 手绘奶蛙害羞捂脸又偷看

description.en: A blushing, hand-drawn Naiwa repeatedly covers its eyes with both hands, then moves them aside to peek with round green eyes. Its pale round belly and dark fingertips remain visible. The public watermark is preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 二维手绘奶蛙脸颊泛红，反复用双手捂住双眼，再稍微移开双手露出绿色圆眼偷看；浅色圆肚皮与深色指尖可见。 公开水印原样保留。

title.en: Naiwa turns and kicks while dancing in a living room
title.zh: 客厅里转身抬腿跳舞的奶蛙

description.en: Naiwa repeatedly turns and lifts a leg into sideways kicks on a wooden living-room floor, moving its hands near its belly; open doors behind it lead to a courtyard. The public watermark is preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 奶蛙在木地板客厅里反复转身，抬起一条腿向侧面踢出，双手在肚子前摆动，后方敞开的门通向院子。 公开水印原样保留。

title.en: Naiwa gestures inside a train carriage

description.en: Naiwa stands in a narrow train carriage beneath a round clock, alternately raising its hands, gesturing sideways and bringing them back in front of its belly. The public watermark is preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 奶蛙站在狭长车厢中，身后上方挂着圆形时钟，双手轮流抬起、指向旁边或放回肚子前。 公开水印原样保留。

title.en: Three Naiwa figures dance in a row

description.en: Three Naiwa figures dance together against a pale background, raising their arms, bringing their hands together overhead, then spreading their arms and stepping with lifted legs. The public watermark is preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 三只奶蛙站在浅色背景前同步跳舞，一起举起双臂、把手合到头顶上方，再展开双臂并抬腿迈步。 公开水印原样保留。

title.en: Naiwa dances on a night street under a tilted camera
title.zh: 倾斜镜头下的夜路奶蛙舞

description.en: On a road at night, Naiwa turns, swings its arms, raises its hands and bends into a crouch as the camera tilts around it, then moves closer; buildings and trees are visible behind it. The public watermark is preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 夜间道路上，奶蛙随倾斜摆动的镜头转身、甩臂、举手并弯腿下蹲，最后靠近镜头，背景可见建筑与树木。 公开水印原样保留。

description.en: Naiwa launches into a tumbling turn on wet grass beside residential buildings, inverts near a low fence and falls forward into a puddle, splashing water outward. The public watermark is preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 奶蛙在住宅楼旁的积水草地上蹬地翻转，身体倒立越过矮围栏附近后扑倒，溅起一片水花。 公开水印原样保留。

title.en: Black-suited Naiwa gesturing toward its face and the viewer
title.zh: 黑西装奶蛙指向脸和镜头

description.en: A black-haired Naiwa in a black suit and pale gloves gestures toward its cheek and the camera, then lifts both hands near its shoulders. Circular lights glow behind it in a dark interior. No microphone is shown. The downloaded public bytes and watermark are unchanged.
description.zh: 黑发奶蛙穿黑西装、戴浅色手套，先朝脸颊和镜头比划，再把双手抬到肩膀附近；暗色室内背景有发光圆环，画面中没有话筒。下载的公开原字节和水印均未改动。

title.en: Necktied Naiwa leading a group dance
title.zh: 系领带奶蛙带领一群同伴跳舞

description.en: A Naiwa wearing a black necktie leads a group of yellow Naiwas in rhythmic arm movements and stepping on a warmly lit stage. The whole published GIF and its small subtitle line are preserved. The downloaded public bytes and watermark are unchanged.
description.zh: 系黑领带的奶蛙在暖光舞台上带领一群黄色奶蛙摆臂、踏步；保留完整公开动图及底部小字字幕。下载的公开原字节和水印均未改动。

title.en: Naiwa clasping its hands and glancing around
title.zh: 奶蛙合起双手四下张望

description.en: A close-up Naiwa brings its gray hands together in front of its chest, looks down and to the side, and opens and closes its small mouth against a dark background. The downloaded public bytes and watermark are unchanged.
description.zh: 近景奶蛙把灰色双手合在胸前，向下和侧面看，小嘴张合，身后是暗色背景。下载的公开原字节和水印均未改动。

title.en: Naiwa smiles with one hand under its chin

description.en: In a close-up, Naiwa smiles toward the viewer with one hand under its chin and its round green eyes open; its pale belly fills the lower part of the image. The public watermark is preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 近景中的奶蛙微笑看向前方，一只手托在下巴下，绿色圆眼睁开，浅色肚皮占据画面下部。 公开水印原样保留。

title.en: Orange Naiwa folds its arms in an angry police pose
title.zh: 抱臂生气的橙色警服奶蛙

description.en: An orange Naiwa in a blue police uniform and cap folds its arms across its chest, with lowered brows above green eyes and a downturned mouth. The public watermark is preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 橙色奶蛙穿蓝色警服、戴警帽，胸前交叉双臂，绿色眼睛上方的眉头紧皱，嘴角向下。 公开水印原样保留。

title.en: Santa-hat Naiwa smiles with folded arms

description.en: Naiwa wears a red-and-white Santa hat and smiles toward the viewer with its arms folded above its round belly. The public watermark is preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 奶蛙戴红白圣诞帽，双臂交叉放在圆肚子上方，正面对着镜头微笑。 公开水印原样保留。

title.en: Dark-brown Naiwa with dreadlocks and necklaces
title.zh: 戴脏辫和项链的深棕色奶蛙

description.en: A dark-brown Naiwa wears short black dreadlocks, layered chains and round pendants, with open green eyes and a slight smile. The public watermark is preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 深棕色奶蛙留着黑色短脏辫，戴多层链条与圆形吊坠，绿色圆眼睁开、嘴角微微上扬。 公开水印原样保留。

title.en: Naiwa bows its head under a starry sky with headphones
title.zh: 星空下戴耳机低头的奶蛙

description.en: Naiwa wears white over-ear headphones and stands with its head lowered before a dark mountain ridge and a star-filled Milky Way sky. The public account watermark at the bottom is preserved. The public watermark is preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 奶蛙戴白色头戴式耳机，垂着头站在黑色山脊前，后方是布满星星的银河天空；保留画面底部的公开账号水印。 公开水印原样保留。

title.en: Naiwa reads a book through black glasses

description.en: Naiwa sits at a table wearing black-framed glasses and reading a book. Its cover depicts a glasses-wearing Naiwa and reads “How to become a cute Naiwa.” A blue plastic chair stands behind it. The public watermark is preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 奶蛙戴黑框眼镜坐在桌前读书，书封面印着戴眼镜的奶蛙和“如何变成一只可爱的奶娃”字样，后方有蓝色塑料椅。 公开水印原样保留。

description.en: Naiwa is posed against a wooden cross before heavy clouds, with both arms extended upward and outward, its hands gripping nail-like objects at the crossbar and its head slightly lowered. The public watermark is preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 奶蛙在厚重云层前靠着木制十字架，双臂向两侧上方伸展、双手握着横木处的钉状物，头微微下垂。 公开水印原样保留。

title.en: Long-haired Naiwa in a Mona Lisa-style portrait
title.zh: 蒙娜丽莎风格的长发奶蛙

description.en: Naiwa has long dark-brown hair and a dark veil-like covering, facing the viewer with green eyes and a small smile in a classical painted landscape with a crackled surface. The public watermark is preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 奶蛙留着深棕色长发，披着深色头纱般的布料，以绿色圆眼和细小微笑面对镜头，画面具有古典油画背景与裂纹质感。 公开水印原样保留。

title.en: Naiwa lifts a foot toward its face in striped overalls
title.zh: 条纹背带裙奶蛙把脚举到脸前

description.en: Naiwa wears pale-pink striped overalls over a light shirt, lowering its eyelids while lifting a dark-soled foot close to its mouth area. The public watermark is preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 奶蛙穿浅粉色条纹背带裙和浅色内衫，低垂着眼睛，把一只深色脚掌举到嘴鼻前的位置。 公开水印原样保留。

title.en: Three Naiwa figures in ornate theatrical costumes

description.en: Three Naiwa figures stand together in embroidered theatrical costumes, elaborate jewelry and crown-like headdresses, with their green eyes clearly visible among the decorations. The public watermark is preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 三只奶蛙穿着绣花戏服，戴繁复的珠宝与冠状头饰站成一排，绿色圆眼从装饰间清楚露出。 公开水印原样保留。

title.zh: 被绳子捆住的坐姿奶蛙

description.en: Naiwa sits against a white background with its feet extended forward and several loops of thick rope wrapped around its belly and arms, looking ahead with green eyes. The public watermark is preserved unchanged.
description.zh: 奶蛙坐在白色背景前，双脚向前伸着，多圈粗绳横绕腰腹与手臂，绿色圆眼向前看。 公开水印原样保留。
